question: Abaana abato omu myaka yaabo ey'okubanza nibashagira omu murimo ogwatebeekanisibwe omwegyesa. Ku baahurira orwimbo, bashemereire kumanya ekirikubiira n'okuzamura kaadi erimu ekishushani ky'ekyo. Ni ki ekirikukorwaho omwegyesa omu by'okwega ebi ebirikugambwaho ebirikukwata aha rurimi rw'ebicurangiro?
answer_a: Okukuba
answer_b: Omunyegyerero
answer_c: Omuranga
answer_d: Amaani

question: Shoma omwegyesa w’ebyeshongozi naakora omukoro gw’okuhurikiza omu kiraasi gw’ekivuga ky’abakongi babiri n’ekitongole ky’abakongi. Omu kuroora, naayita abegi kumanya enyiriri z’ebyeshongozi za buri mukongi kandi bateekateeka ngu ebintu byombi birikukwatana nk’abarikugamba. Ekigyendererwa kikuru ky’omukoro ogu nikyo ki?
answer_a: Kukora omutindo gw'okuhurira omunda
answer_b: Higa omutindo gw'okusiima oburungi
answer_c: Shweekuruza ebiri omukukora enshonga y'omukura.
answer_d: Kukura omuringo gw'okwoleka ebi orikuteekateeka orikukoresa omubiri gwaawe

question:
Shomaisho omwegyesa naayenda kutebeekanisa eshaaha nyingi z'amasomo aha mutwe "Omukumo: ebyahandiikirwe n'okuririmba". Eishomero arikukoreramu riherereire aha rubaju rw'orurembo.
Ni mutindo ki gw'omukumo ashemereire kutandika nagwo, kubaasa kworeka ngu omutwe ogu guriyo omu mukumo ogumanyirwe abeeshure b'eishomero eryo?
answer_a: Rapu
answer_b: Ebirango by'omuziki ogurikurugamu
answer_c: Okuririmba omuhandiiki
answer_d: Omukumo gw'ebika

question: Ni enki aha bigambo by'omuziki ebi orikugira ngu nikyo kigumire kukwata omu kutandika kwega omuziki omu mashomero ag'abana?
answer_a: Okuhindura omu mwanya gw'edoboozi
answer_b: Okutaanisa amarangyi
answer_c: Okuhindura omuringo gw'okupima
answer_d: Okuhindura omukuruzo

question: Ni eki aha ebikorwa ebi nikikusiisa omukoresa endagiriro y'ebicweka by'amanota nk'obuhwezi bw'okuhandiika enyimba?
answer_a: Shisha omukono ogurikuhakanisa omu ndimi ezirikukwatanisa omu bweshure bw'amaraka g'abantu baingi
answer_b: Runginga omugambo gw'enyimba oguhandiikirwe kurugiirira aha ku guraikiriza.
answer_c: Kucwamuza emigongo y'ebicweka by'ebicurangiro by'amajwi agiingi, nk'omuringo gw'okwetebeekaniza omu kwega eby'okuririmba/eby'okucuranga
answer_d: Manya ebiranga nariyo n'omuringo ogurikukoresibwa omu mwanya ogwo omucweka gw'omuziki kurora n'okucwara.

question: Ni murimo ki ogurikukiraho obuhikire kukoresa omu bwire bw'okuhurikiza omutwe gw'okucwekyereza nk'ekihumurizo ky'okwongyera aha bwengye bw'eby'obuhangwa omu baineishomero abatamazire kumanya eby'okucwekyereza?
answer_a: Shobora ebice byona ebiri omu ku hurikiza
answer_b: Reeba omuhendo gw'ebintu by'obutonde bw'ensi omu kasumi aka orikuhurikiza.
answer_c: Handiika orutondeeka rw'ebintu ebirikukozesebwa omu kwegyesa ebirikureebwa omu kuhurira.
answer_d: Shushani orhangane amarangi n'emishushani n'obwire obutali bumwe obw'okuhurikiza

question: Teekateekateeka embeera egi: Omuhwezi w'enyimboozi omu isomo "Enyimboozi n'obusinge bw'ebihurira", abuuza abeeshuri be, nk'omurimo gw'eka, kweshomesa aha bikorwa by'obuhunguzi n'eby'akabi eby'ebihurira, amajwi maraingwa, n'amajwi mato. Muhwezi w'enyimboozi arikukurira ki n'omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Kushwijukya kumanya oburemeezi n'emiringo y'okureeta omuranga
answer_b: Kureeta abeeshuri haihi n'obuhangwa bw'ebihurira kurugiirira omuhanda gw'oburungi.
answer_c: Kushobora kumanya omugano gw'amajwi agu abantu bashobora kuhurira
answer_d: Kugira ngu abegi be babe nibamanya obwingana bw'ebintu ebirikukwata aha mururu

question: Ni enki aha mirimo egi orikukiraho ekihikire kukoresa omu kucungura okwegyesa kw'ebyeshagarizo n'ebindi bintu ebirikworekwa?
answer_a: Kukora okuteekateeka orutaro norukukoresa emikono y'ebishushani bya solfège
answer_b: Kukuba emikubo mingi omuhendo gurikukoresa omubiri.
answer_c: Kucweereza enyimba n'omuringo gw'okuranga ebaraara omu nyimbo
answer_d: Reeba okwegamira kw'omugisha gw'okukora omu biri omunda y'omubiri gw'abeeshuri.

question:
Obu baine kukora n'abegyesa aha kigyendererwa: 'Okukoresa ebara omu muringo gw'okushushaniisa ogwa "impressionist".'
Niki ekikora abegyesa obutahikiriire obusinga obwingi obu barikugeza kuhikiiriza amabara g'omutaano omu kwegata kwabo?
answer_a: Gyeragye omubara gw'aha hamwe na omwiragura kugira guhinduke omwiragura muno
answer_b: Gyeragye omubara gw'ahansi n'ogurikugwatanisa kugira ngu otungye ekisiima
answer_c: Gatangaanisa ibara rya kabiri na white (omweru) kureetera kyerere.
answer_d: Gatangaanisa irangi y'omusingi emwe n'endiijo y'omusingi kugira ngu oboneho eyakabiri.

question: Omugyezaho orikwegyesa n’abeegi be aha biteekateeko by’erangi ezirikushushana. Omu ishomo, omwe aha beegi be amubuuza: “Omu magara ga butoosha, erangi erikushushana ekoresibwa ryari?” Omu biteekateeko ebiri ahansi, nikirikyi kirimu eky’okureeberaho ekirikukwata aha nshonga eki omwegyesa araabeasa kuha omweegi we?
answer_a: Omu miringo erikukozesibwa omu bwengye bw'okushanga ebitambaara, erikushushana n'emiringo y'obushaho
answer_b: Kuhandiika n'omurungo ngyenda ngyereka ebi ndikumvoora omu mutima.
answer_c: Ku ndikora ekishushani ky'ekitabo
answer_d: Omu ibara erikugyenda hamwe kandi rikoleesa, nk’eky’okureeberaho, omurongo gw’ebbaasi kugambwa ngu nigumanyisa

question: Omwegyesereza orikwegyesa naayemerera omu maiso g'eklassi naayegyesa eby'okucapa, omwe aha banyeshuri be yamubuuza: Omuringo gw'okucapa ki ogurikwetwa intaglio kandi ahabwaki? Omu biteekateeko ebi orikuza kutoraho, nikikuru ki eki omwegyesa arakuheereza kishoborora ekibuuzo ky'omunyeshuri?
answer_a: Okubazisa omuti, ahabw’okuba omuti gubazibwa n’ebikoreso ebirikucwa n’ebindi ebirikutangaanisa ebirikucwa munonga omu muti ogurikubazibwa.
answer_b: Okucapira omu mutanda, ahabw’okuba ekkalaamu erikurabamu omu mutanda ogw’obucweka bwingi kuhangaho ebicweka nk’empapura, engoye, nari ebindi
answer_c: Okubajja n'okusiiga rangi y'amaizi, ahabw'okuba ekiriisa kiba kishingamiire omu miyongo eyakozirwe omu lupapula rw'ekyoma, n'ahabw'ekyo, ekicweka ekicapiirwe nikiruga omu miyongo y'ekintu ekikozirweho hatariyo ahaiguru yaakyo
answer_d: Lithography, ahabw'okuba oburemezi bw'eibaare erikukoresibwa, hamwe n'amaani aga printeri ekoresa, nibireeta ekishushani ahu ingi erikworekwa n'obuhagazi bukye.

question: Omuhwezi omu ishomero erito, omugabe naagira ekigyendererwa eki: 'Kukuraaza obushoboorozi bw'okureeba, okutooroora, n'okwegata kw'ebintu ebirikureebwa omu butoosha kuraba omu kweshushaanisa.' Kutiisa eki, omugabe naayeta abeeshuri kuza omu butoosha bw'omuhanda ya haihi n'eishomero n'ebitabo byabo by'okweshushaanisamu n'ekaramu zaabo. Endinganizo y'emirimo egiheereza abeeshuri kukora ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Roorana eby'omugasho byona ebirikushangwa omu mwanya ogu orikureeba, obanze obirange omu bwooya nk'omuringo gw'okubyoreka.
answer_b: Reeba omuhendo, ocondooreze ekitabo ekirikukushemeza, ohingure ebishushani n'emiringo omu kikubo, reero okoresye omushana n'ebicweka ebirikuziika.
answer_c: Reeba omuhendo, yegyereze ebintu ebikuru ebirikureebeka omu kashushani akaatooranirwe, ohabure oburemeezi bw'ebishushani, okukoresa omurongo nk'omuringo gw'okwoleka ebi orikuteekateeka.
answer_d: Shoborora ebintu by’omugaso ebirikureebwa omu bwengye bw’ensi, reero ohingure ebice by’omu mwanya ogurikwenda kureebwa omu kabooki k’okushushanya.

question: Ni engyenderwaho ki erikukirayo obuhikire omu kuhandiika omurimo, kuhwereza abeeshuri kwetegyereza omuringo Jackson Pollock yaakozesize kukora ebishushani?
answer_a: Kukoresa ebishushani ebirikutaana kureeta omugyegyerezo omu kuboneka.
answer_b: Kukoresa eby'omubiri kureka akaremo akarikugambira omu bishushani
answer_c: Koresa obusinge obutari bumwe n'enyegyesereza ez'omutwaro ogutari gumu
answer_d: Koresa ebishushani ebi otarikwetenga omukushoborora kugira ngu okore ekikombe ky'ebishushani.

question: Ni murimo ki ogurikukiraho obuhikire kworeka abeeshuri omuringo gw'okureeba ebintu omu bwengye bwabo omu mutendera gw'okushushana ebintu nk'oku biri (emyaka 12 kuhika 14)?
answer_a: Shaba abeeshuri kweshushaniisa ekintu kyona ekiri omu bwengyezi oburikureebeka kuruga omu dirisa. Bwanyima, obagambire kuza hare n'edirisa, bakeeshushaniise ekintu kikyomwe, hanyuma bagyeragyeranise obunene oburikureebeka omu bishushani byombi.
answer_b: Shaba abeshomesa kukora ekishushani nk'eky'omushushani orimu ebintu ebirikureebeka omu bwengye (landscape) erikworeka obureezi bw'omuhanda (perspective) n'obureebeko bw'omuhanda bubiri (vanishing points), reero obagambire kugaragura ekishushani kyabo n'eky'omushushani ogwo, nibareeba obureezi bw'omuhanda (perspective).
answer_c: Shaba abeshomesa kushushaniisa omurongo gw'obugarukiro, bateekeho obutonye bubiri obw'obugarukiro, reero bashushaniise ekibu n'okugyeragyeranisa ebishushani ebirukugwaamu na banywani baabo omu kelasani.
answer_d: Mugambire abeeshuri kwetebeekanisiza ekyorekano omu barikushoboorora amateeka g'okukoresa omurongo gw'ahaiguru (horizon line) kurugiirira aha bishushani ebi barikukunda.

question: Omugyezaho ki abegi bashemereire kukora, omwegyesa arikukora aha mutwe gw'ekishushani n'abegi omu kiraasi ey'omwaka gwa mushanju, atasya kwetantaza omugisha ogwo?
answer_a: Kukora okubaruura omuhanda ogugororokere n'okushara.
answer_b: Gyerera omushana n'ebicweka by'omwirima ebirikworekwa omu maisho g'omunywani waawe omu klasse.
answer_c: Kukopa ebitundu by'omu maisho omuhendohendo, nk'enyindo n'amatu
answer_d: Shushura omugyera gw'omutwe, oteekeho ebicweka byagwo omu bunyakare oburikugyererana.

question: Omugyezaho naaba naakora aha mutwe gw'ekicweka kya Cubism n'abaana b'ekyangahe kya mukaaga kandi naashoboorora oku abantu barora ebintu. Ni enki aha bintu ebi ebi abaana barikubaasa kukora kubaasa kwetegyereza ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Kora omukubo gw'okukoresa ebicweka by'ebintu ebirikushushana n'ebyo omu kukora ekikombe ky'ebishushani.
answer_b: Hindura ebara omu kishushani ky'obucubi obw'okucwekyereza orikukozesa ebara ezitari zimwe
answer_c: Kora omugani gw'okubazamu ebintu ebirikushushana n'ebiriho, orikworeka ebintu bingi omu bwengye oburikushushana.
answer_d: Kukora ekishushani ekirikushushana n'eky'omushushani w'omutwe ogwa "cubist" orikukoresa empapura z'amaraangi g'emiringo mingi n'ebintu ebirikukwata omu mikono omu muringo ogutari gumwe.

question: Omugyezibwa naayenda kwiha abegi be omu izooba ry'ebishushani by'omutindo ogurikukwata aha bintu ebirikureebeka, aine ekigyendererwa ky'okusiima omutindo gw'ebishushani ebiriyo. Omu kubakyendeza, omugyezibwa abaheereza akatabo akabanduura okusiima kwabo; baine kutoora ekishushani ekibarikukunda bwanyima bagarukemu ebibuuzo ebimwe. Katabo aka kaine kwetengwa ebibuuzo ki ebirikubaasa kubahwera kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Omutwe gw'omurimo n'oguha kandi nigwo guri omu muringo ki? Noogusiima ota kandi ahabwaki?
answer_b: Omwandiki w'omulimo n'oha kandi ebimukwataho ebikuru ebyamubaireho nibiriha? Ahabw'enki wahisire omulimo ogu? Nigwegaita guta n'ebyafaayo byaawe?
answer_c: Omurimo ogwo gushingamiire aha muhinduko ki? Negukoresa emiringo y'obuhangwa erikukwata aha muhinduko ogwo?
answer_d: Niki ebimanyiso ebirikureebwa omu by'obugombe ebiri omu murimo ogwo owaatooranize? Ebimanyiso ebyo nibishushana bita n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwoleka ebiri omu murimo ogwo?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ari kukora aha mutwe gw'ekigambo: "Ebishushani by'Abantu Abamanyirwe omu Ihanga" arikuhanga ebishushani ebirikworekwa omu buringanire bubiri; aha muheru gw'enteekateeka, nayenda kushwijuma ekigyendererwa: "Okuteekateeka aha mirimo y'abantu abamanyirwe omu ihanga omu bwire obu." Ni kirorro kya kushwijuma ki ekirikukwata aha kigyendererwa ekyashangwa?
answer_a: N’ekirikushobora kushoborora okutorana ekishushani ky’omuntu orikukirayo omu bantu abakozirweho omu kushushana kwabo
answer_b: Shisha omuzingo gw'omutindo ogw'amaani aha bukuru n'obushoboorozi bw'ekifaananyi ky'omuntu orikukirira abandi omu bantu.
answer_c: Ngyenda nk'oku ndikwetenga omuntu ou owaagizire omuhanda gw'okutwara omu bwire obu.
answer_d: Narikiriza omuringo gwe bwite ogu akakozesa kukora ekishushani ky'obuntu.

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omwe gwa 5 kworeka abegi be ebishushani bya Chile kuruga omu bwire obutali bumwe, nashoborora emiringo mingi abashushani bakoresa omu irangi, emiterere, hamu n'omushana. Hanyuma, nabaasa abegi be kutoorana ekishushani, ekitali nk'ebyo bareebire, kwetegyereza kimwe ebintu ebyo by'orurimi rw'okureeba ebyegesiibwe. Obuhereza, abegi nibayanjura okwetegyereza kwabo omu kiraasi. Omwegyesa nagyerereza omurimo ogwo arikukoresa akatabo k'okugyerereza.
Ahabwenki okukoresa omuringo ogu kurungi kugyerereza ekigyendererwa ekiragwirwe omu murimo ogwabanza?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba kirimu okukora ebintu omu miringo etari emwe emwe eshemereire kw’ahukanizibwa kuguha omweeshuri eby’okugarukamu.
answer_b: ahabw’okuba orubuuri rurikukiriza omuringo gw’okugaitamu obubonero n’enzito
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba rubriki neyikiriza kushishoora hatariho kuta omurengo nari okucwera omucwezi orubanja aha kintu kye akakozire, kureka aha muringo ogu yaakozeseize kukikora.
answer_d: Ahabw’okuba omubazi nigwija kwikiriza kutorana ebirungi kuruga omu bushoborozi obukozirwe abeeshuri

question: Shoma omubaire okugyerera aha: Omwegyesa ayorekire abegyesa ab’omu mwaka ogw’omunaana ebiragiro by’okushomesa ebi birikukoresibwa kushomesa ekigyendererwa eki: “Kushoboorora ebyorekyerwe ebirikureebwa omu bwire obu, orikureeba obumanyiso bw’omuringo gw’okugambira, ebintu ebirikukozesibwa, n’orurimi orurikureebwa.” Omu biteekateeko ebi, nikiki ekirikwetagisa kuba kirimu omu biragiro by’okushomesa?
answer_a: N’ekirikushobora kushoborora enyehurizi ezirikworekwa omu murimo ogwo
answer_b: Nyakagambira okusiima kwe ahabw'emiringo y'obuhangwa ekoresibwe omu murimo ogu.
answer_c: Nokukoraana omukago hagati y'emiringo, oburyo obukozesibwe omu kubihanga, hamu n'amanyiro g'omulimo.
answer_d: Ekiragura ebintu ebirikumanyisa ebiri omu murimo n'ebihikaana n'ebyafaayo by'omuhandiiki.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa kwenda abegi be kumanya okushoborora obwire bwa Baroque kurugiirira aha muringo gw'eby'obuhangwa, niki eki bashemereire kwesigamiraana kukuru omu kwega?
answer_a: Ebirikumanyisa enjawulo aha bikorwa by'okuririmba n'ebicurangiro
answer_b: Okumanya obuhangwa bw'ekyevugo kya basso continuo
answer_c: Kumanya abahandiiki b'enyimbo abamanyirwe: Vivaldi, Bach, Haendel
answer_d: Kwetegyereza ebiranga eby'omugasho ebyatandika n'ebyaraangirira enkomerero y'ekiro, omwaka gwa 1600 na 1750, omuhendo ogwo.

question: Ni ki eki aha mirimo egi ekirikukirayo kugira omugasho omu kutebeekanisiza omuziki gw'ebicurangiro omu ndimi ina n'ekikundi ky'ebicurangiro ebirikukira ebiri omu rurimi rwoona?
answer_a: Kuteerereza kushoma buri kimwe omu bitundu noroonda n'engaro otarikugamba.
answer_b: Okukuba ebicweka by'omuringo gw'omuziki oguri omuri buri murongo
answer_c: Okukora hamwe omulingo gw'okucweeka enyegyeserezo y'enjunga enkuru y'ebyesigwa.
answer_d: Okukora omulimo hamwe n'ebintu byoona ebirikukora omurongo gumwe

question:
Shoma omugisha-mwegyesa ayorekire abegyeswa be vidiyo, egi erikubereka ebintu ebirikukwata aha mbeera y'okukora emizaano y'omu bwire bwa Renaissance n'emizaano y'omulembe ogu abegyeswa be barikwega. Reero, abagambire kugyeragyeranisa emizaano erikworekwa omuri vidiyo, nibakwata aha bintu bitari bimwe ebirikukwata aha mbeera y'okukora, nk'ebintu ebirikukwata aha miringo y'okuzina, embeera ei barikuziniramu, n'omugasho gwabyo.
Ekigyendererwa kikuru ky'ekicweka eki omuri eshomero nikyo ki ekirikukurikiranwa omu murimo ogurikugambwaho ahaiguru?
answer_a: Okutwara omuhendo gw'okweyoreka kw'omubiri okutari kumwe
answer_b: Okuteekateeka munonga
answer_c: Okuteerera kw’okucwamu
answer_d: Okuhiga kw'okwegamya omuziki n'enzira z'okwoleka endiijo

question:
Kushooma omurimo ogu:
Kugira ngu abegi bategeere omugasho gw'okutwara orurembo, abegi nibakora omurimo ogurikukurataho:
Omu bibiina, nibagabana endirimbo zaabo, nibashoboorora kandi nibahakanira omugasho gw'okutwara orurembo aha banywani baabo.
Omurimo ogu nigwiija gukomeerezebwa guta kwongyera aha kuteekateeka aha mugasho gw'okutwara orurembo?
answer_a: Orikugyeranisya ebirango by'enyimba
answer_b: Orikugira omugasho gw'abantu omuri society nigumanyisa ki
answer_c: Kurugambisa omuhendo gw'emigisha y'abantu omunda y'ekibiina
answer_d: Kuruga omuzingo gw'enyimba n'omuringo ogukozesibwamu

question: Shoma omubaire w’ebyeshagarizo by’omuziki naayeta abegi be kukora omutindo gw’okukomanga omuhendo, omu, okubanza, abegyesa omugambo gw’omuziki ogw’omutindo ogwa hagati, reero omugambo ogw’akabiri. Omwegyesa naakora emigaambo omu rukurato orurikukurataho: 1. Abegi boona hamwe nibakoma ogw’okubanza; reero ogw’akabiri. 2. Eicweka ry’ekicweerere ky’abegi nirikoma ogw’okubanza n’eicweka erindi ogw’akabiri, nukwo nibakora omutindo gw’okukoma ogurikukwatanisa emigaambo. 3. Abegi boona omu kasumi kamwe nibakora omutindo ogu bakozire, baitu hati omu bubiri bubiri. 4. Enyima, abegi nibatorwa kukoma omugambo gwona ogw’omutindo gw’okukoma ogurikukwatanisa emigaambo. Mutindo ki ogurikukuzibwa munonga omu bikorwa ebi?
answer_a: Ebirikuta
answer_b: Ekibiina
answer_c: Obumwe
answer_d: Enyegyesereza y'omubiri

question: Shoma omwegyesa yaaba nashoboorora ebika by'obwire omu ক্লাসে, akareeba ngu abegi baingi tibarikubaasa kwetegyereza ebika by'obwire ebirikugira omuhendo gumwe gw'okukonyeera kwonka bikatandukana omu kugaburwa (2/4 na 6/8, 3/4 na 9/8, 4/4 na 12/8). Ni murimo ki omwegyesa orikubaasa kukora okuhwera abegi kwetegyereza enshaanjuura ezi?
answer_a: Rebyuura y'omuziki erikworeka enshuraniso ezi.
answer_b: Hindura obwire bw'okucwekyereza omu ndirimbo ezirikwenda kworoha orikukoresa omucweki w'ebitabo by'endirimbo
answer_c: Mureebere orurembo omuri 6/8 n'abeeshuri, reero obwo bukya, ohindure engyenderwaho yaarwo kumureeba omuri 3/4.
answer_d: Shobora omukono gw'okubanza n'ogw'okushatu omu kubarwa kw'omutima kurugiira aha bumanyi bw'abeeshuri omuri fractions.

question: Omu klasa, abeeshuri baine kworeka omu mazima endimi z'enyimba ezirikurugana. Ni engyenderwaho ki erikworeka gye obureezi abeeshuri abarikukura omu bikorwa ebi?
answer_a: Okuteega orikushobora kwetantara

Ni birikurataho byona ebiteekwa kubaa omu murongo ogurikwija kushwijuma ekigyendererwa ekirikumanyisibwa?
answer_a: Yeese ebishushani ebiri kworeka emiramu ekwatagaine n'omubiri nk'ekirikukwasira
answer_b: Kukora okunoonyereza kw'ebitabo aha biteekateeko ebirikutaana ebirikukwatana n'omubiri nk'ekirikuhwera.
answer_c: Kuhanga ekishushani ky'eky'okurorraho rundi omutindo gw'ebyambaro ogurikukora aha kizibu ky'omubiri nk'ekirikushagika.
answer_d: Nokukora omuhanda gw'obuhangwa omu by'okukozesa ebirango by'okuhanga ekikozirwe nk'eky'okwambara.

question: Omwegyesereza naayegyesa n'abegyeswa be aha biteekateeko by'eby'obuhangwa ebirikugyenda. Kureetera abegyeswa kumanya gye, abereka ebishushani ebirikushoboorora ekyo. Omu biteekateeko ebi orikuza kureeba, nikikuru ki ekirikwohereza eky'okureeberaho kirungi eky'eby'obuhangwa ebirikugyenda?
answer_a: Ebishushani by'ebibira n'obugaragaro bw'obutonde
answer_b: Ebifaananwa by'amaju g'etangaaziibwe nk'ebintu by'eihanga eby'omugasho
answer_c: Ebyombo kuruga omu muco ogwa ira
answer_d: Eby'afaayo n'ebigambo by'omu kanwa

question:

Ni by’okwegaho ki ebirikwetagisa abanyeshuri aba kubaasa kukora omurimo ogu, ebirikukwata aha miringo y’okushushana?
answer_a: Okukoresa ebishushani ebirikwegaita hamwe kureeta emiringo mishasha
answer_b: Okukoresa ebara zitarikushushana n'ebizima aha bintu bitari bimwe omu bwengye bw'ensi
answer_c: Okukoresa omuhendo gw'ebara ry'omubusaho omu miringo nk'ekicweka kya mbere
answer_d: Okukoresa eirangi eririkumwaata kwolesya ebisiisi

question: Omurundi gwa mbere, abegi b'omwaka ogw'okubanza omu mashomero ga Secondary nibashomesa okukoresa okutema embaaizi nk'omuringo gw'okwoleka ebi barikuteekateeka. Kureetera kumanyisa omuringo ogu nigutwariramu ki, omwegyesa nakoresa eky'okureeberaho kuruga omu magara ga buri izooba kumuhwera kucwamu n'omuringo gw'okubaza ebishushani. Omu biteekateeko ebi orikurora, eki kikukworeka omuringo gw'okucwamu eki embaaizi erimu?
answer_a: Ekyacwekyerwe kuruga omuri mashini y'ekopi omu ishomero
answer_b: Omukono ogurikushangwa aha sitampu y'omunyamabanga omu ishomero
answer_c: Engaito aha kaadi y'omwegi erikumworeka.
answer_d: Eky'okubonera aha ngaito z'abanyeshuri aha etaagi y'ekika kyabo

question:
Omugyezibwa naagyerera akakoreso k’okugyezesa okushobora kw’abegi kukora Stop Motion.
Ni endaga ki aha zirikukurataho erikworeka ngu abegi nibakora gye omulingo ogu ekintu kirikukorwamu omu kukozesa embeera z’omulingo ogu ekintu kirikukorwamu ezirikukwata aha nkora egi?
answer_a: Kuhandiika ebishushani by'ebintu nari abantu, okubikozesa omu mbeera y'omugani kuraba omu bishushani by'omugani (comic strips)
answer_b: Nokukwata ebishushani by'ebintu rundi abantu omu mulingo ogugyenda gukuratana, noohindura obunaku bwabyo omu mulingo muto.
answer_c: Eshura ebintu bitari bimwe omu muringo ogutari gumwe ogw'okushushaniisa ebintu.
answer_d: Nagyenda ebiriisa yaabo omu muringo ogw'ekyeburaaya ogukozeseza ebifaananyi by'emiringo mingi

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu by'okuririmba, omwegyesa w'abaana abato ateekaniza eky'okukora ekirikugyenda kukora aha bintu bitari bimwe eby'okuririmba. Omurimo ogw'okubanza nigwo gw'okureetera abaana kuhurikiza omuriro ogurikurugamu aha teepu erikutoona reero bagugarukyeho kuraba omu kushiisha engaro. Ekirikukurataho, baine kugarukamu omurimo ogwo omu kuhurikiza okuteeba kw'eshaaha. Ni kintu ki ky'orurimi rw'okuririmba ekirikukorerwaho n'ekyo ekyakozirwe?
answer_a: Okukuba kw'omutima
answer_b: Ebirondoozi by'endimi
answer_c: Obwirengyerero
answer_d: Amaani

question: Ni ki ki ekikorwa ekirikugira obugumiki bw'amaani omwegi bw'arikwega okucwara ekiboodi ky'amashanyarazi?
answer_a: Okucweereza omuryo n'ebihimba by'omuziki
answer_b: Okushambagira n'obucweka oburikukora kandi oburikuhinduka omu muringo ogurikwetegyereza
answer_c: Okukora omuzaano ogwa rallentando
answer_d: Okucweereza arpeggio n'omukono gw'omushooni

question:
Shoma omwegyegyesa omwe:
Omu kiraasi y'abanaishomero ab'omukaaga/omw'omushanju, omwegyesa w'enyimbi naayeta abegi kukoresa ebanga ry'ekyombeko kwegendereza barikuhurira orutindo. Nibashabwa kumanya oburemu n'amaani ebi barikubaasa kwetegyereza n'emibiri yaabo. Bwanyima, omu butongole, nibarikiriza aha mutindo gw'okuhimbisa amaani g'enyimbi: nikibaasa kuba okukutama, okushisha omukono, n'ebindi. Nibahurira enyimbi kandi buri katongole kahimbisa omutindo gwabo omwe aha omwe ngu buri omwe areebe abandi. Kikoreso ki ky'okushomesa eki omwegyesa ashemereire kukoresa kureeba ngu abegi nibatoorana ebintu by'orurimi rw'enyimbi?
answer_a: Rubriiki
answer_b: Ebirikwate kw'okukora ebintu
answer_c: Ebyahandiikwa ebirikukwata aha biteeso by'omwegi
answer_d: Omugisha gw'okushomesa

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho:
Omwegyesa omu kiraasi ya 5/6 narozaho omuringo gw'ebicweka bishatu ebirikukuratanisa, aine ekigyendererwa ky'okukuraaza omu banyeshuri be obushoboorozi bw'okuhurikiza n'okwega okushoma n'okuhandiika enyimba.
1. Ekicweka ekya mbere ky'omuringo ogu nigikwata aha kukora ebishushani eby'obusingye ebirikugeza kworeka ebintu ebirikuhurikwa kuruga omu kuhurikiza n'okwetaba kwabyo.
2. Ekicweka ekya kashatu nigikwata aha banyeshuri kurondera enyimba ezirikworoora, ezitaine bipimo bingi n'entebeekanisa erikworoora, omu matwi.
Ni murimo ki ogurikubaasa kuteekwa omu kicweka kya kabiri nari entaaniso y'omuringo ogu?
answer_a: Shoma ekicweka ky'ebyeshungirwe by'omuziki
answer_b: Shoma omubazi gw'omuziki
answer_c: Omuzingo ogurikukuratirwa
answer_d: Okozaho ekishushani kya Venn

question: Shoma omwegyesa omu burembo bwa 6, omu mutwe ogurikukwata aha miringo y'omuziki omuri Latin America, nayenda kugyeragyeranisa Ekigyendererwa ky'Okwega ekirikukurataho n'abegi: 'Okucura n'okuhanga omuziki kuraba omu kukoresa ebyo bamaze kukuratamu n'obwomeezi bwabo okurikugyenderera aha biragiro ebi baheebwa.' Ebirikukurataho nibiha omugisha okushwijuma ekigyendererwa eki twagambaho?
answer_a: Nibakora emiringo y'omuziki erimu endengo ezihikire omu rwijwi rw'omuziki ogurikukoresibwa.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza ebirikukwata aha by'omuziki ebirikukoresa ebintu bitarikumanyirwa omu miringo etarikwihikaana n'ebyahandiikirwe.
answer_c: Nibaijukire omuziki n'ebirikoreso ebi baahangire, nibakurata endimiito.
answer_d: Nibakwatiriza endengo z’omurimbo n’ebicweka by’omubiri, nibatebeekanisiza endengo z’omurimbo ezihaire nk’oku barikwenda.

question: Shoma omwe orikukurataho: Omugyezibwa w'enyimbi omu kashatu k'omwaka ogw'omukaaga, omu mutwe "Enyimbi z'ebicurangiro ebirikukwatanisa", nayenda kukora omurimo ogurikwija kumwemerera kukuza ekigyendererwa eki: "Kugamba, orikworeka obwingi bw'okuhangwa n'obucureezi, okuhurira, ebirikumeeza, n'ebitekerezo ebirikurugirira omu nyimbi ezirikuhurikwa n'ezirikukorwa, orikukoresa oburyo bw'okugamba obutari bumwe (okugamba, okukoresa omubiri, enyimbi, okureeba)". Murimo ki ogurikukorwa abeeshuri ogurikuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Omu kuza omuhendo gw'ebicweka by'omu firimu erikumanywa muno omu kicweka ky'okwegyesa bworaamara kuhurikiza orurembo rwayo
answer_b: Kugira omusingi gw'obuhangwa bw'ebihurira kurugiirira omu mweshongoro
answer_c: Teera omukoore ogurikworeka enkyukakyuka z'emitima ezigirwa omuntu bwamara kuhurira omuziki.
answer_d: Hanga obucweka bw'enyimba oburikworeka enyehurira nari okuteekateeka okurikurugirira omu bintu ebirikuba biriho omu firimu ez'omutaano.

question: Teekateekateeka embeera egi: Omwegyesa omu omuri ক্লাসা ya mushanju nayenda kukuuza okwega okurikukwata aha bikoreso ebirikworeka, okukiraho amaani n'okuzaana. Ni bumanyi ki abegyi bashemereire kuba baine obwo bakikora kwega oku?
answer_a: Okushoma omu rurengo
answer_b: Okushoma kw'ebyeshangizo
answer_c: Emitwaro y'ebihurira
answer_d: Okukora omurimo n'ebirikoresibwa

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa omu kiraasi y'omunaana omu by'okuririmba ateekanisa omutwe gw'enyegyesa ogurikugira ngu 'Engyenderwaho z'Okukura kw'Enyimba'. Ni nshonga ki abeeshuri bashemereire kuba nibamanya kare kubaasa kwetegyereza ebirimu omu mutwe gw'enyegyesa ogurateekanisiibwe?

answer_b: Ebirangi

answer_d: Okukura kw'enyimba

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho:
Omwegyesa omu kiraasi eya munaana, omu mutwe "Abahandiiki b'enyimba abahambire", nayenda abegyi be kukuza okuhendera n'obwegendereza enyimba ezahandiikwa Ludwig van Beethoven. Eki nikibaasa, baine kukora omurimo ogurikugyenda hamwe n'enyimba n'okwoleka omubiri.
Kiki ekirikukiraho obuhangwa oburikubaasa kukozesebwa kushuuruura omulingo gw'okuhikiiriza omu kwoleka, okushoboorora, n'obuhangwa omu bicweka byombi n'omulingo byombi birikukwatana?
answer_a: Ekitabo ky'ebikorwa
answer_b: Rubriiki
answer_c: Ebirikurora
answer_d: Omugisha gw'okushomesa

question: Omugyezaho omwegyesa akakorera hamwe n'abeshuri omukibiina kya 5 omu mwaka aha bushobozi bw'okuririmba kuraba omu kubaza ebiteeko by'enyimba. Emyaka eshatu bwanyima, omwegyesa akagaruka kwegyesa ekibiina ky'abeshuri abamwe, hati bari omukibiina kya 8 omu mwaka, kandi nayenda kukora aha bigambo n'obushobozi bumwe: okuririmba kuraba omu kubaza ebiteeko by'enyimba. Omuringo ki gw'omusingi gw'omuringo ogukwataine n'ekicweka ky'orurimi rw'enyimba ogu omwegyesa arikukoresa?
answer_a: Okutaanisa: Kandi kureeta okwega, ekicweka ky'omuziki ekirikwetengwa kigyerereze kukwatana n'obureezi.
answer_b: Okutaanura: omutwe gw'enyimba ogurikukoresebwa omu nyimbo nigugaburwa omu bitundutundu ebicweeka ebirikukorerwaho butoosha.
answer_c: Okweyongyera: omugisha gw'orurimi rw'ebicurango nigwo gureetwa omurundi ogundi aha mutindo ogurikweyongyera omu bwingi.
answer_d: Okugarukamu: omuringo gwe'by'okuririmba gumu gushemereire kukorerwaho emirundi mingi, okubanza kurabira omu kwegyerera hanyuma n'okushoma.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Omu rurembo rw'eby'obushomesha, abeeshuri b'ekyangahe kya mukaaga bagyenda kureeba ebishushani ebirugire aha bisika, bari hamwe n'abareeberezi baabo n'abeeshuri. Bwanyima, omu ishomo eririkukurira, omwegyesa abagambira kushushana ekishushani ekikabataire omutima ahabw'ebintu by'orurimi rw'okureeba n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwohereza obutumwa. Aha muheru gw'eishomo, omwegyesa akungaania ebishushani kwetegyereza. Kurugiirira aha bishushani ebyakozirwe abeeshuri, omuringo ki ogu omwegyesa arikubaasa kukoresa kworeka abeeshuri omu kwetegyereza ebishushani ebyo?
answer_a: Yoreka ebishushani by'abeeshuri kandi ohingureho okuhikaana kw'ekibiina aha bikwaata aha rurimi rw'amaisho n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwetegyereza ebi abeeshuri barikworeka.
answer_b: Buzibye abeeshuri ebibuuzo ebirikukwata aha biteekateeko by'orurimi rw'okureeba n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwohereza omu kubajja ebishushani omu bbugo, mureete okuhikaanisa ebirowoozo omu rukurato.
answer_c: Orikiriza omukubagano noroho okukoresa ebishushani kuruga aha bamanyamahanga abakugu aha by'okushushani omu bbugo n'okwetaba omu kwetegyereza omugasho gw'orurimi rw'amaisho.
answer_d: Yoreka abashomi ebishushani by'ebisigye ebyareebwa, ohabuurire abeeshuri omukago oguri ahagati y'ebiteekateeko, orurimi rw'amaisho, n'obugarukiro omubyo byatekwa.

question: Shoma eky'okurugiirirwaho eki: Omu kiraasi ey'omwaka ogw'omukaaga, omu mutwe gw'eky'okwegyesa 'Obutonde bw'eby'obuhangwa: eby'obuhangwa by'omulembe ogu', omwegyesa ayolesa abegi be ekigyendererwa eki: 'Omuhanga ekishushani ekirikukoresa ebintu kurugiirira aha kwetegyereza eby'oburungi bw'omulembe ogu'. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurugaho ezirikubaasa kwikiriza okukora aha kigyendererwa eki ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Noonyereza aha bikwatiraine n'ebishushani ebirimu ebintu eby'amaani eby'omushushani omwe orikukuratirwa; ohingure ekishushani ekirikukozesa amaraangi ga acrylic okurikwingana n'ekya omwe aha bashushani abu orikwegaho.
answer_b: Shwijuma emirimo y'obushushani bw'ebintu; ohingureho obushushani bw'ekintu orikukoresa ekintu eki otorohoire omu magara gaawe ga buri izooba.
answer_c: Reeba emirimo y'okushushana ey'ebintu; yorekana emitamu yaayo enkuru ahabw'omushinga.
answer_d: Shobora eby'okushushani ebikozeseza ebintu byenyima kandi ogereranise emitwe n'ebintu by'orurimi rw'okureeba.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi eya 6, omu mutwe 'Okuhanga ebintu ebirikureebwa, omuntu n'obutonde', omwegyesa naagira ekigyendererwa eki: 'Kuhanga omulimo ogurikureebwa ogurikushangwa omu biteekateeko by'abegi, kurugiirira omu bintu ebirikukuumira obutonde'. Aha mirimo erikukurataho, niki ekirikubaasa kukora kugira ngu ekigyendererwa ky'omwegyesa kishobororwe?
answer_a: Hanga ekishushani ky'omubara gw'omubisi gw'ebihogo ekirikworeka ebi orikukunda.
answer_b: Baaza ekishushani ky'omuti ekirikworeka omutwarize gwaawe ogurikukukwata ahakintu kikuru.
answer_c: Yombeka ekishushani orikukoresa 'papier-mâché' kurugiirira aha biteekateeko by'obuhangwa bw'omwanda
answer_d: Teeka ekipande n'ebikozesebwa eby'okugaruramu ebikuhiga abantu kuta omucaara omu ishomero

question: Shoma omwegyegyesa orikwegyesa omumyaka gwa 6 nagamba aha muringo gw’okubaza ebishushani owa xylography. Yoreka abegi eby’okureeberaho bingi kandi yashoboorora omuringo gw’okubaza n’okucapa ebishushani. N’obwengye obu, abegyi abagira ngu bazaale ebishushani ebirikubaasa kukorwa omu muringo ogu. Ku atandika kutaayaayira omu kicweka kureeba oku abegi barikugyenda, areeba ngu ebishushani ebimwe birimu ebigambo. Omwegyesa areetera ekicweka kwemera, atwara ekishushani kimwe nk’eky’okureeberaho kandi yashoboorora ekirikubaho nkaaba ekigambo kibazairwe omu kintu ekirikucapwaho nk’oku kiri omu kishushani. Ni kikora ki eki omwegyesa araakore kwegyesa abegi kukora ekintu ekirikucapwaho omu muringo ogurikwenda?
answer_a: Yegyesa ekishushani omu matirisi norikukoresa ekaratasi y'omukaara
answer_b: Yoreka eky'okucapira ekishushani omu muti (xylograph) kworeka ebiruga omu kubaza.
answer_c: Teeka endirooro aha kikopo ekishushani kireebeke nk'ekyahindurwa.
answer_d: Shushani omu bbaaburaadi ebbaruha kushoborora enyegyesereza ez'omutaano omu kubahangaanisa obuhangame.

question: Omu klasa y'omukaaga, omu kutandika kw'ekicweka "Okubaza", omwegyesa naayenda omu isomo ly'okubanza omurimo ogu orikukurata abaana: teekateeka eby'obaza byaawe bwanyima obibaze omu kabooki kaawe k'eby'okubaza. Hanyuma, n'abagambira kureeta ebintu nk'omugata, eky'okutandikiraho, engoye ezikozirwe, n'emiringo etari emwe n'emwe ey'obutonde n'ey'omuntu omu isomo eririkukurataho. Omu isomo ly'akabiri, kuraba omu murimo gw'omukago, abaana bashemereire kuzooka ekicweka n'ebintu ebiragizibwe, kubaasa kureeta ebi barikuteekateeka omu bwomeezi. Isomo ly'akabiri nirihikaana aha kicweka ki ky'omuringo ogurikwetenga ogw'omulingo gw'okuhanga?
answer_a: Okugerera
answer_b: Omuteekateeki
answer_c: Yoreeta kandi ogabure
answer_d: Teekateeka kandi ozaare ebiteekateeko

question: Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho: Abeegi abari omu kiraasi eya 6 nibatandika omutwe ogugambirira aha "Kukuraaza okusiima oburungi bw'ebintu ebirikureebwa." Okukora eki, nibakora omu bubiri nibashuuruura emikutu ya Internet ey'amamyuzeyamu g'ebintu by'obuganga bw'omulembe ogu, nibatoorana omurimo gw'obuganga kandi nibashaka ebikukwatiraine nagwo. Kandi omwegyesa n'abaha omukuratanise gw'emirimo omu ntambwe shatu, okubahigaana omu kucwecura. Omu mikuuratanise egi erikukurataho n'enki erikubasisa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ekigambirwe?
answer_a: Shobora ekishushani; yoreka ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omu kushushana; shwijuma omuringo gwakyo n'ebirikukirimu.
answer_b: Teekateeka aha muringo gwayo n'ebirikukirimu; shaanuura ebintu by'orurimi rw'okureeba; shoboorora ekishushani.
answer_c: Shoborora omuringo n'ebirikukirimu omu kishushani, yetegyereza ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omu kureeba; manya ebyafaayo by'omuhangi.
answer_d: Manye ebyafaayo by'omuhangi; shweekuruura emiterere n'ebirikukirimu; yetegyereza ebintu by'orurimi rw'okureeba.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa w’ekika kya munaana natandika omutwe “Okuhanga ebintu ebirikureebwa, omuntu n’obutonde.” Omu kiraasi, abeeshuri nibega aha mukumo gw’eby’obuhangwa bw’ensi kurabira omu mirimo erikworeka, bwanyima nibatebeekanisibwa omu bibinja kuhanga ekicweka kurugiirira aha mukumo ogu gw’eby’obuhangwa. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, niki ekirikukurataho ky’ebikorwa ekiraabe kirungi kusinga byona kwegamira ekigyendererwa ky’omutwe?
answer_a: Reeta ebintu ebiruga omu butonde, obindaze omuhendo gwabyo.
answer_b: Reeba omu miringo y'eby'obuhangwa ebiireho, obone kukora ekishushani kuruga omuri yo.
answer_c: Tebeekanisa okukoresa n'okuhangaanisa ebintu by'obutonde hamwe n'okubikora omu mwanya.
answer_d: Shwijuma engyenderwaho z'okubangaanisa ebintu n'ebirikukora omu butonde bwa Ruhanga, oyesuure obukuru bwazo omu kuhandiika ekicweka ky'omugasho.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi y'omukaaga omuishomero erikuru, omu mutwe gw'okucapa, omwegyesa naayenda abegi be kukora ebicweka by'emiringo emwe. Ni by'okwegaho ki abegi abaine kuba baine ku baaba nibenda kugyenda omu maisho omu murimo gw'okukora ebintu by'emiringo emwe?
answer_a: Okukoresa n'okuhindura omutaano nk'amata
answer_b: Okutonda n'okukora emirimo erikuronderana
answer_c: Kukoresa n'okuhurikiza obwengye omu murongo
answer_d: Okukwata n'okuhanga ebicweka n'ebikoreso ebirikushaanana

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu mwaka gwa munaana, omu mutwe gw'eky'okwegyera "Okuhanga ebintu ebirikureebwa, omuntu n'obusinge", abegi nibakora omurimo gw'ekikundi ogw'okureeta ebintu ebirikureebwa hamwe n'amajwi ogurikukwata aha busaho omu kitongole kyabo. Kandi omwegyesa ashemereire kumanya yaaba bamalirize emirimo eyaherizeho, nk'okuhanga ebishushani by'ebirikwija kureebwa, okukwata vidiyo mpango omu kitongole aha mutwe ogwo, n'okuhandiika ebyahandiikirwe ebirikukwata aha vidiyo, ebirija kwongyerwamu omu murimo gwabo ogurikureeta ebintu ebirikureebwa hamwe n'amajwi. Omu bintu ebirikukurataho, ekirikukwata aha kubazaho nikyo kirungi okukoresa kumanya yaaba bamalirize emirimo egi?
answer_a: Ekitabo ky'ebikorwa
answer_b: Ebirikurondooza
answer_c: Rubriki y'okushwijuma ey'obucureezi
answer_d: Eky'okukuratira eby'omwana nk'okuhendera

question: Omuhwezi omu kiraasi ky'omunaana, omuhanda gw'ekicweka "Okushushana n'Obutonde," omugabe naayoreka ekigyendererwa eki: "Okwombeka ebishushani by'ebintu ebirikwoleka obuhame kuruga omu butonde." Omu mirimo y'okucungura egi erikukurira, niki ekirikwija kureetera omugabe kumanya ngu ekigyendererwa kikahiirweho?
answer_a: Reeba omukago oguri ahagati y'enyonyi n'enyanja y'obwato, otebeekanise ekishushani ekirikushoborora omukago oguri ahagati y'emiterere n'emitwarize yaabyo.
answer_b: Reeba omu muringo gw'ebintu eby'obutonde ebirimu okuringana, reero okore omushororongo ogurikworeka omukago oguhikireho n'ebintu by'okutebeekanisa
answer_c: Reeba ebintu eby’obuhangwa ebirikukora nk’eky’okureeberaho, reero okore omurongo gw’obwire ogurikworeka enkyukira eky’ecwiremu kuruga obu kyataireho kuhika hati.
answer_d: Reeba omukago oguri ahagati y'ebintu ebirukozirwe n'obutonde, reero oyombeke ekintu ekirikutooreza omuringo nari empindahinduka y'ekintu ekiri omu butonde.

question: Shoma embeera egi: Omu klasse ey'omukaaga, erimu abeesiga kukora omu bibinja kuruga aheeru y'eklassse, omwegyesa nayenda kukora omuringo gw'okwegyesa ogurikwenda kugyenda aha kigyendererwa ky'okukora "ebintu ebirimu oburemu". Omu miringo y'okwegyesa egirikukurataho, n'oguhe ogurikukwata aha mutindo gw'okwegyesa n'embeera y'abayegi?
answer_a: Reeba omu butonde bw’ensi, mukore ebishushani hamwe kwombeka ekibumbe kuruga aha kimwe aha bintu ebi, kandi mukoore ekibumba ekicweka.
answer_b: Reeba omuhendo gw'ebyombeko omu obutura oburi haihi, mukore enteekateeka, kandi muzoore ekishushani ky'omutaano omu bununu omu murimo gw'ekibiina.
answer_c: Reeba ebishushani by'okushushana eby'abashushani ab'omulembe gw'okushushana (impressionist), oroorere obureingwa bw'ebibanza byabyo reero obitureebe omu buhingiro bw'ahaiguru, okuraba omu kukora hamwe.
answer_d: Reeba omu bwire bwabo obwa buri izooba, otorane ekintu kimwe okyahindure kurugiirira aha byetengo ebi murikwenda hamwe n'abanywani baawe omuklassi.

question: Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi y'okubiri y'ahaiguru omuri unit y'enyimba za symphony, ekibiina ky'abanyeshuri nikiteega Bolero ya Ravel. Omwegyesa naabagyezaho kuhurikiza omu miringo etari emwe n'emwe ey'okutebeekanisa enyimba egi. Murimo ki ogurikukiraho obuhikire abanyeshuri kwombeka okuteekateeka kwabo aha murimo oguhurikiriziibwe?
answer_a: Shwijuma omuguzo gw'enyimba ogurikukiriraana ogwombekirweho enyimba egi.
answer_b: Shwijuma omugasho ogurikuruga omu kikorwa eki kurabira omu bintu ebirikukwata aha mairu
answer_c: Huura omuringo gw'okuhandiika n'obwire obu gwaikiriiremu
answer_d: Shisha ebikoresho ebirikukozesebwa omu murimo n'omugasho gwabyo

question:
Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho:
Omwegyesa w'ebyeshongozi ashaba abegyeshwa b'omwaka ogwa kabiri kukwata ebirooto by'ebyeshongozi, kubaasa kwega n'okukora ebigezo n'ebikoreso by'okuhindura ebyeshongozi omu buringwa bw'omubazi. Reero abagambire ati:
- Bakorese reverb obwo oburooto burikugamba aha bibanza birikujwara kandi bikomire.
- Bakorese low-pass filters obwo oburooto burikugamba aha by'okwerinda, ebisiigi n'obwerinzi.
- Bakorese fuzz distortion nari waveshaping obwo oburooto burikugamba aha kuhinduka kw'omutwe.
Kuba nikyorobera kumanya yaaba abegyeshwa bakakoresa ebi bikorwa omu bwire oburikwetagisa, niki ekikoreso ky'okushomesa ekirikukirayo obuhangwa ngu omwegyesa akorese?
answer_a: Rubriiki
answer_b: Ekitabo ky'ebikorwa
answer_c: Ebirikuta by'okureeba kurugaana
answer_d: Omugisha gw'okushoma

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Abeegi abari omu mwaka gwa kashatu gw’aha secondary bari omu kutebeekanisa omuziki gw’okworeka omu konsati y’omutwe gw’omushomesho egiirikukwatwa ishomero ryabo. Omugurusi waabo narinda abeegi omu myeezo 10 ehari kandi nakuuta omugisha gwabo, narora n’emitwarize yaabo n’obushoboorozi bwabo okutunga omulimo hamwe n’enkura y’obushoboorozi bwabo bw’okushoboorora obwengye bw’omuziki. Ni bikoreso ki omugurusi ashemereire kutoora ahabw’omulimo ogu?
answer_a: Rubriiki
answer_b: Ebirikurukurwa
answer_c: Eky’okutwara ebyafaayo by’omwana nk’okuhandiika ebimukwatireho
answer_d: Eky’obuhangwa eky’okureeba n’okuhurira

question: Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi y'ebyeshure eya Middle School, omwegyesa nayenda kushwijuma abegyi omumwe omumwe aha bwesigye bwabo omu kushoma n'okuhandiika enyimba. Kandi okukora eki, omwegyi weena naija kuheebwa ekaagati y'amanota erimu orunyimba ruto kandi rworobi oru bataazire kukimanya. Abegyi nibaija kurushoma omu bunyoro okurikiraaho barushoboreze omwegyesa barucumuure kurungi aha xylophone. Kikoreso ki ekirikubaasa kukoresibwa omwegyesa kureeta amakuru g'emitwarize y'obwesigye bw'omwegyi omwe na omwe omu kushoma n'okuhandiika enyimba?
answer_a: Ekitabo ky'omwana eky'emirimo
answer_b: Ebirikurora
answer_c: Eky'okushangwa nikikorerwa omwegi kandi kikahandiikwa.
answer_d: Omugisha gw'okushomesa

question:
Omugurusi orikuruga omu Ishomero erya hagati, omu mutwe gw'eby'okwesomesa 'Emita', aroonda eby'okureeberaho ebirikuhurikwa ebiirikushobora abanyeshuri be kwega kworeka emita ya 2/4, 3/4, na 4/4.
Ni enki aha biteekateeko ebi omunyeshuri ashemereire kuba amaze kwega atakaikiriize kwega kutooroora emiringo y'emita etari emwe arikukoresa amatu?
answer_a: Omugyegyo
answer_b: Omuringo
answer_c: Eihangiro
answer_d: Okugambira kimwe n'okushoborora

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi y'abanyeshuri ab'omwaka gwakabiri, omwegyesa aine ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa omuringo gw'okubumba omu kubajja. Kutaangira eikaraasi, omwegyesa aroonda eky'okureeberaho ekiraamuhwere kumanyisa abanyeshuri omuringo ogu gw'okubajja n'embeera zaabo eza buri izooba. Ni ndaihe aha mbeera ezirikukurataho erikwija kwihiiriza omwegyesa kureetera abanyeshuri kumanya omuringo gw'okubumba?
answer_a: Tebeekanisiza gelatine
answer_b: ijuza eccupa n'amaizi
answer_c: Ta omu omunyanja omu ibumba ry'ekijuma.
answer_d: Kuraho ebinyobwa omu maganda gaabyo

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu ishomero rya wakati, omugurusi naayenda kukoragana n'abanyeshuri aha by'okubanza kw'ekicweka ky'orurengo oru abantu barikugyendera, kurabira omu kworekwa okutari kumwe okurikureebwa omu mwanya gw'abantu boona ogw'ekicweka ky'abantu abarikwegaita nabo omu ishomero. Aha mirimo erikukurataho, n'oguhe ogurikukwata aha kukoragana n'abanyeshuri aha by'okubanza kw'ekicweka ky'orurengo oru abantu barikugyendera, okurikurugiirira aha ekyo ekimaze kugambwa?
answer_a: Taaha omufaano gw'omurabyo gw'eishomero.
answer_b: Teeka omukono aha kipande ekirikukwata aha kureeberera n'okukoresa otya ebintu ebirikushangwa omu tauni omu muringo murungi
answer_c: Kuhindura omubazi omu kwihirira aha biteengo byaawe n'ebirikukureetera obuteerwa.
answer_d: Teeka ebimanyiso kurugiirira aha kwetegyereza ebi eshuuru erikwetenga

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurira: Omu kiraasi ky'abegyesa ab'omwaka gwa ikumi na ibiri, omu mutwe 'Okucungura endimi z'obuhangwa bw'omuri obu bwire', omwegyesa nayenda kushoboorora abegyeswa be, kuraba omu kikora, omuringo gw'okukora sitensiro. Omu biteekateeko ebiri ahansi, oruhe rwaine orurikubaasa kumushobooroza kukora eki?
answer_a: Taaha omuhendo aha sente n'ekikoreso ky'okutaahamu, reero ogyeme.
answer_b: Shuuga esente, ogyete omu langi, reero orite omu lupapura.
answer_c: Higa ekaraamu aha rupapura orikusharira aha bicweka
answer_d: Shuura esenteeni aha rupapura orugyerere kandi orangiire okurikuruguruka.

question: Shoma omwegyesa orimu omwaka gwe ogw'okubanza n'abegyeswa be ab'omu mwaka ogw'okubanza omu somero erikuru, aha muheru gw'ekicweka 'Okushushana Ebishushani aha Rubaho', nayenda abegyeswa be kukora okweyeshonga kwabo kwonka aha mugingo ogurikukurira: 'Kushongora ebishushani byabo, orikureeba omukago oguri hagati y'ekigyendererwa ky'okwohereza, ebintu ebikozesibwe, n'orurimi rw'amaisho'. Ni murimo ki ogurikubaasa kupima oku omugingo ogwo gwaahirirweho?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebintu by'orurimi rw'okureeba ebikozesibwe omu mirimo yaabo y'ebisenge by'okubajjamu.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza ebishushani byabo barikureeba omutwe gw'enshonga, ebikoresho ebirikukuumira obutonde, amarangiri, emiterere, n'emirongo erimu omu bishushani ebyo.
answer_c: Nibarikukora ebigezo n'ebintu ebirikukoresibwa ebirikushushana omu nshonga y'omushinga.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza emikago hagati y'ebintu ebirugire omu butonde ebikozeseibwe omu purojekiti n'emishushani, enkingi, emibala, n'emitwarize ebirikuteekateekwa.

question: Omuhiga omu 7 omuriira ry’okucurra, omwegyesa ari kukora quodlibet y’ebicweka bishatu. Ebicweka by’okucurra bishatu byona byegyesibwe abegi boona, omwegyesa abagaburamu omutindo mushatu, naaha omutindo gumwe buri mutindo. Ku araabe naayegattisa ebicweka by’okucurra, omwegyesa ashemereire kurekyeraaho okucurra ahabw’okuba omutindo gumwe nigugyenda omu maisho kandi quodlibet neeyangaara. Niki eky’okukora ekirikukirayo oburungi aha rubaju rw’omwegyesa kucuura ekizibu eki?
answer_a: Buri gyeitu lyona niriza kucweereza orurembo rwagyo, abandi boona babaze nibahurira kandi bategeere ebicweka ebirukukiraho omu mikorere y'eky'okurwanisa.
answer_b: Omuririmbo nigwijwa hamwe, baitu buri kibina kigooba kwikiriza aha izooba ryabo kuba nibamanyi ekitundu kyabo, nukwo hatagira bibina ebirukirira omu kwingira omu rurembo.
answer_c: Ebibiina ebitarikugenda omu maisho omu kwijaho nibiija kucweereza endirimbo zaabo ezirikukwatanisa, n'ahabw'ekyo ekibiina ekirikugenda omu maisho nikibaasa kuhurikiza gye omuringo orikukora quodlibet kurugiirira aha muringo gw'okucweereza.
answer_d: Eklaasi eryija kuhurira eby'okureeberaho bya quodlibet kwetantara aha ruririmbo rumwe, reero aha rundi. Ekigyendererwa n'okubahwera kwetegyereza omukago gw'amajwi n'obukuru bw'okukuumira aha muhendo ogutahinduka.

question: Omu klasa y'omunaana, omu mutwe "Okwoleka n'okutungaaza", abeeshuri nibashabwa kukora omuziki kuraba omu kukoresa ebintu bitari bimwe by'orurimi rw'obuhangwa. Ahar'ekyo, omwegyesa naija kukora omugasho gw'okutooroza n'okuhanga, ngu bwanyima buri kibinja kigire ebi barikukuratira omu kuhanga kwabo okw'omuziki. Niki ekiraabe kiri ekikoreso ky'okwegyesa ekirikukwata aha mugasho gw'okutooroza n'okuhanga ogu?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naija kuha ihingurizo ry'ebyeshongo, aharikwija kugaragarira ebintu bitari bimwe by'orurimi rw'ebyeshongo ebirikubaasa kukoresibwa kukora ebishongyezo. Omu muringo ogu, etimu nizija kutunga obutungi bw'ebyo zirikwenda kukora.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa naija kukora omukoro gw'okuhanga. Ahabw'omukoro ogu, emiringo y'ebihangirwe neija kukururwa omu ntebo. Omuringo gwona gwabaire gushoborokera, nibaija kubaasa kushoboorora emigashe ki y'orurimi rw'ebicurangiro erikubaasa kukozesebwa kwumisa omuringo ogwo.
answer_c: Omugyezibwa naija kuha abaana endeesa ina z'okubindura. Omu ndeesa yoona, orubaju rwayo, endeesa ey'okubanza neereeta amani; eya kabiri, emiterere; eya kashatu, emiringo y'ebicurangi; eya kana, obwire. Buli kibinja kishemereire kukora ekicurangi kuruga omu bintu ebi baatooraine ku ndeesa ezi babindwire.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naija kubaha ekigyenda ekya crossword ekya omuziki. Nibaija kukijuzya obu barikuhurira ebintu bitari bimwe ebirikukoresibwa omu kuhanga ebyeshongoro ebi omugyezibwa arikubareetera kuhurira. Crossword ku erimala kujuzibwa, etimu ziryagira ebintu bitari bimwe ebi ziryakukoresa kukora ebyeshongoro byazo.

question: Omugyezibwa, omu isomesa omu kiraasi eya 5, arikukora aha mutwe gw'okuteerereza n'okusiima, nakora omusiri gw'amasomo, oguraahwere omu kuha omulimo gw'okugyerera okumanya kw'ekigyendererwa "Okwoleka ebi orikuhurira, ebirikumutegyereza, n'ebirikukurugirira omu ruriimbo". Ni kiratwa ki aha birikukurikira ekirikwoleka ekigyendererwa ky'okwega eki kirikumanyisibwa?
answer_a: Nibarikira abantu omurimo ogukozirwe omu kasozi
answer_b: Nibarikiriza omu mibiri yaabo obu barikuhurikiza omuziki gw'ebintu n'emirwi.
answer_c: Nibwooreka obuhangwa omu kworeka kwabo okw'omuziki nk'abantu omuri boona hamwe n'ekibiina.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza kandi bacweereza omuziki oguruga omu nsi ezitari zimwe, nibata omutima aha muriro gw'omuziki gwabo.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omu mwaka gwa munaana n’omwegyesa naayegyesa omwegiirwa emyegyesa yaabanza aha kiiboordi. Bakozireho okumara obwire oburikukira aha kwega omuringo gw’okwemerera, omuringo gw’okuteeka engaro, n’okukoresa ekigyere ekirungi. Omwegyesa akagira enshonga ezirikukwata aha mwegyesa omu miringo etari emwe n’omu biro bitari bimwe n’omwegiirwa, kurugiirira aha ku omwegiirwa arikukora n’ekirikugamba. Omu biteekateeko ebiri ahansi, nikikyo ki ekirikworeka eky’okureeberaho ky’ebirikugarukwamu ebirikugyenda nibitunga kurugiirira aha ku omwegiirwa arikukora?
answer_a: Okakurata, otyo kyona kikuru kyaba kirungi munonga. Oine eiraka rirungi, kwonka nitumanya ngu noobaasa kukora kurungi okukira aha.
answer_b: Ijuka ziragire ngu okucwara kw'orurembo nikwo 1-2-3-1-2-3-4-5 kandi emikono eshemereire kuba ehangamire aha mubiri.
answer_c: Otarikweragura okugyaho ekigyere kyaawe aha kagyere akaryo obu omuhendo gw'ebitabo gworeka, ngu obumwe bw'endengo tibureebeka butarikuteekateekwa
answer_d: Emyanya y'emikono negyenda nungi. Hati ekishigireho n'okwega okukozesa engaito z'engaro kugira ngu otungye orurembo orwahairemu.

question:
Omu omwegyesa omu kiraasi eya mushanju, omu kubazooka omulimo omuhandi, ogurikukwatana n'omutwe gw'okukuba ebintu ogurikugira ekigyendererwa "Kukuba omulingo gw'ebintu bingi omunshonga ya 6/8", omwegyesa ateekaniza abegyeswa kutandika omulimo ogwo.
Omu miringo egi, niki ekirikworeka okwegyesa okurikutegyezwa?
answer_a: Okukuba polymeters omu muringo gwa compound ternary
answer_b: Okukuba ebipimo bya binary na ternary kuruga ahamutindo
answer_c: Okugamba emiringo erikugwerana omu muringo gw'omugano ogwombiri oguteeraine
answer_d: Okukuba emiringo etariyo mishushanire omu muringo gw'ebiri n'ogw'eishatu

question:
Omu omwegyesa omu kiraasi ky'omunaana naija kworeka abegyeswa omulingo amani ag'enjawulo agakozesebwa omu bweshure obu barikukora.
Ni enki aha bikorwa ebi abegyeswa bashemereire kuba bamaliize kukora kare kubaasa kwetegura ebirimu ebi?
answer_a: Kwetegyereza ebirango by'omutindo gw'oruyimbi
answer_b: Okushoma kw'ebigambo n'okubihindura omu muringo ogurikwenda.
answer_c: Okukora ritardando, accelerando, na rubato
answer_d: Okushoma omulingo omururu gw'ebintu ebikozesebwa omu kubihairemu amani nigukora

question: Omuhwezi omuhinguzi omu kubazibwa kw'ebiro by'okumahembera omu mwaka gwa munaana, omu bwire bw'okucweereza hamwe ebintu ebirikukoresebwa, ekigyendererwa nikyo: "Kuhanga n'okucweereza orwimbo orurimu omukuru gw'ebicweka," omwegyesa ateekaniza abegi kworeka ebi bahangire. Endaga ki aha ndaga ezirikukurira ezirikworeka ngu ekigyendererwa kyahikiirwe?
answer_a: Nibarikora orwimbo omu rurimi orurikukwata omutima orurikugarukwamu n'okuhindurwa kwingi.
answer_b: Nibarikora orwimbo omu ruririmbo orukuru orurikugarukwamu omu muringo gumwe n'ebigambo ebirikumaraana.
answer_c: Nibakora orwimbo omuri rwo oruririmbo oruhyaka orurikumanyisa nikurondera oruririmbo orukuru.
answer_d: Nibarikora orwimbo omu ekyo ekicweka kyaahaheru nikyongyerwa aha muheru gw'omuryo gw'okubanza

question:
Omuhwezi omu bareegi ya mushanju, omugyezibwa naatandika omutwe “Okuhanga omu Bunene”, arikugyenderera aha kiragiro “Omuhanda gw’okuhanga emirimo erikureebeka kuruga omu biteekateeko by’omuntu, arikweegaana n’ebikozesebwa ebirikugumaho omu kubumba”. Omu ishomo ry’okubanza, omugyezibwa nayenda abeeshuri kushemererwa omulingo gw’okubaka ebintu ebirimu obunene arikukozesa ebikozesebwa ebirikugumaho.
Niki ekikozesebwa ky’okwegyesa ekirikukwata aha bwengye ekirikukirayo obuhikireyo kukora aha kushemererwa kw’abeeshuri aha mulingo ogu?
answer_a: Vidiyo y’ebirikurugamu ebyakozirwe kuraba omu bintu ebyakozirweho kandi ebikozirweho omurundi ogundi
answer_b: Okureetera abantu ebishushani eby'ebibumbe ebyakozesebwa kuruga omu bintu ebirikukozesebwa butoosha omu mukura (digital presentation)
answer_c: Ekiragiro n'enkora y'okubumba ekishushani n'ebikozesebwa ebikoziremu.
answer_d: Ekyerekwa ky'ebishushani ekirikworeka omuringo gw'okubaka ekintu omu buninki omu kubiika ebintu ebirikukoresibwa butoosha

question: Omuhendiisi omu bitebe by’okubanza omwenda, omu mutwe gw’eky’okwegera “Ebishushani n’okwoleka oburungi bw’abakazi n’abashaija”, akora okushwijuma kw’okubanza omu kuhingura kw’omurimo gw’okukora ebishushani. Omu kushwijuma, omuhendiisi areeba ngu abegi nibayehuzya aha kigambwa ky’okwoleka obwomeezi n’okukoresa emikono n’omubiri omu kwoleka omuntu. Aha mirimo eri hansi, niki ekirikubaasa kukora kurungi okuhikiiriza oburemeezi bw’okwega obwolekerwe?
answer_a: Shisha enshobi omu kuhandiika ebishushani by'obuso omu biteekateeko by'abeeshuri, reero obabuze ahabw'enki zabaireho.
answer_b: Yoreka oburemee oburikworekwa omu bishushani by’abantu n’oshoborore emisingye y’okushomesereza hamwe n’ebirikukoresibwa omu kushomesereza
answer_c: Tebeekanisye eby'okuragira ebirikukora aha kworeka ebirikukora aha kworeka omutima n'okushwijuma ebiri omunda ebirikureeta oburemeezi omu bishushani by'abahanga abakumbeegye.
answer_d: Rondora omusingi gw'ebirikukwata aha biteekateeko by'ekicweka eki ebikwata aha bintu ebirikworeka omu kubumba n'okuhindura ebirikworeka oburemeezi oburikukiraho abeeshuri.

question: Omuhwezi omuhango omu "Kuhanga ebintu ebirikureebwa, omuntu n'obutonde", omu giraade ya munaana, omugyezibwa naagira ekigyendererwa "Kuhanga emirimo erikureebwa erikurugiira aha kwesiima n'okucwekyereza ebyorekyerwa ebirungi ebirikukwatana n'omukago oguri hagati y'abantu, obutonde n'obusingye." Nk'okushwijuma okw'okubanza, omugyezibwa naashaba abegi kutoorana omurimo kuruga omu byafaayo by'obuhangwa ogurikworeka omukago ogwo ogugambirweho. Ku yaaba naashwijuma emirimo, naamanya ngu abegi baine okumanya kukye aha kyakushabwa, ahabw'okuba ebishushani ebyatooranirwe nibyoreka obutonde bw'ensi oburikukirayo kumanywa. Muringo ki ogu omugyezibwa arikubaasa kukoresa kwongyera aha kumanya kw'abegi?
answer_a: Rooramu ebitabo by'okurorraho, obimurikye omu kiraasi, oteekye abeeshuri bakore ekishushani nibatekereza aha nkyukakyuka y'obwire.
answer_b: Haa buri omwegi ekitabo ekirikukwata aha bintu ebirukukirayo obukuru, omureke akishambaanure arikukozesa obukoki, reero oshireho ebirivaamu.
answer_c: Haa buri omwegi ebikwaata aha by'okushoma, mutoorese okuteekateeka aha nkyukakyuka y'obwire, reero mube n'ebihendo by'obuhangwa ebikwaata aha mutwe ogwo.
answer_d: Yoreka eby’okurorraho ebirukukwata aha nshonga, oteeke abeeshuri bashooremu omurimo gumwe, kandi oragiire okwetegyereza n’okucweekereza omurimo ogwo n’okushoborora akakwate hagati y’omurimo ogwo n’okuzooka kw’obutonde bw’ensi.

question: Omu omwegyesa omu kiraasi ky'omwaka ogwa 7, omu bwiire bw'okukura ekicweka "Okuhanga omu bwanga oburikworeka obumwe bw'omuraari", n'akora aha kigyendererwa "Okukoresa ebintu n'emisingi y'orimi rw'okureeba kworeka obumwe bw'omuraari". Okukikora, abaire asaba abegyeswa kukora purojekiti omurikwo, kuraba omu kukwatanisa ebintu, bahange ebanga ry'ekyombeko kyabo. Omwegyesa naija kusesa ebirugamu n'akakoomi. Ni birikukurataho ebirikworeka obukuru bw'okwegyesa oburikwija kworeka obusinguzi bw'okwegyesa oku?
answer_a: Nibarikoresa ebishushani eby'ebifo ebyatoorainwe kubihindura omu muringo ogubashemeza kubaasa kuta omukikaro.
answer_b: Nibakora ekitabo ky'eky'okureeberaho ekirimu emiringo etari emwe ey'empapula z'okubambaho omu bisenge by'ekyombeko.
answer_c: Nibarikoresa okubingaanisa ebicuucu by'ebishushani by'ebintu kwombeka obusaho bw'ekyombeko.
answer_d: Nibakoresa tekiniki y'okucebya n'okutaaha omu kucweera enyanga ezirikukora obusa bw'ekicweka.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa ক্লাসে ya 8 ari omuri ক্লাসে ya hagati y'ekicweka "Okuteekateeka n'Obuhangwa bwa hati," abegi abarikukora aha mirimo yaabo y'obuhangwa ekwatiraine n'ekigyendererwa "Okoora vidiyo y'okuteekateeka erikurugiirira aha magara gaawe." Abegi bari omu kicweka ky'okutebeekanisa ebi barikwenda kukora, ebi omwegyesa arikwija kushuuruura arikurugiirira aha biragiro. Ni kika kya kamanyiso eki omwegyesa arikubaasa kukoresa omu biragiro kushuuruura okutebeekanisa kw'emirimo y'abegi?
answer_a: Nibarikora, bagutoraniriza ebicweka, kandi bagyenda nibahindura ebintu ebirikureebwa n'ebirikuhurirwa.
answer_b: Nibarikora omukago hagati y'ekigyendererwa ky'okwohereza ekiri omu murimo gwabo n'eky'abandi.
answer_c: Nibarikorera omushoonzi gwabo ogw’ebidiyo, nibateekateeka aha bintu ebirikukora ekifo eki gurimu n’oku gurikukwatana n’ebidiyo.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza kushoborra omuringo gwebarikukoresa, nibatekereza aha mitwarize, ebikoreso, omuhanda, hamu n'omukoranire hamwe n'abareebi

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa orukurasi rw'omwaka ogw'omukaaga, aine ekigyendererwa ky'okukora "Omurimo ogurikukurira aha misingye y'ebya'buhangwa bw'omuri obu bwa hati".
Ni enki aha bikorwa ebi ekirikubaasa kukora kurungi, nk'entandikiro, abeeshuri kwetantara ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Kushwijuma emirimo y'abandi banywani baabo kandi bagabe ebi barikuteekateeka.
answer_b: Taaha amashuushani kurugiira aha biteekateeko ebi orikwenda, reero ogwoleke omu kiraasi.
answer_c: Ronda omutwe gw'ebiro ebi turimu, reero ogworekye omu miringo y'okukora ebintu n'omubiri.
answer_d: Shuuruura omuringo gw'okwegyesa orikukoresa ebintu ebi otarikumanyira kukoresa ebi orikuba oine haihi.

question: Omwegyesi omu omwaka ogwa kana omuishomero erikuru ari kukora aha mutwe "Ebirikukoresibwa omu tekinologia omu bwengye bwitu obw'ebicurangari". Ekigyendererwa kimwe ekirikushangwa omu ntebeekanisa ye n'okuba abegi bamanye kandi bamushobore kumanya enshonga z'omuriro ezirikukoresibwa aha iraka n'ebicurangari (reverb, delay, n'ebindi). answer_a: Ekikondooro ky'okugumya eddoboozi
answer_b: Omukoreso gwa MIDI
answer_c: Ekikoreso ky'okuhindura omuranga
answer_d: Ebirango by'enyimba ezirondirwe

question: Omu omwegyesa omu kiraasi ey'okushatu omu mashomero ga secondary, omuri ইউনিট "Ekikundi ky'Ebintu ebiriisa", atebeekaniise ebiro by'okwegyesa arikugyenderera ngu abegi bashohoze amateeka gaabo bwabo ag'okuhandiika ebintu. Kuruga omu muringo gw'emirimo ogurikukurataho, ogu abegi baraakore, nigu gwabugana gye kukora aha mugyenderero ogwateirweho omwegyesa?
answer_a: Nibakora ebiteekateeko by’omulingo gw’ebicweka by’omulembe, bakamanya emigarukiro yabyo, kandi bateekaho endirimbo n’obuhangwa bw’amalaka, nibalonda ebyo birukugwana gye n’omulingo gw’ebicweka by’omulembe. Hanyuma, nibateraaniza omulimo ogwo, nibahunuura enshobi, kandi nibayoreka omulimo gwabo abandi, abarikugamba aha byarugiremu.
answer_b: Nibamwe nibamwe nibooreka ebi barikuteekateeka omu maisho g'ekibiina kyabo. Nibatoorana eki barikuteekateeka ekirikukiraho kwemerera ekibiina n'okuhenda kwabo omu by'okuririmba. Bwanyima nibeesherura kandi bakakikora nk'ekibiina. Hanyuma, nibashwijuma ebirugiremu omu kubihindura kuba birungi ahabw'okubyoreka ahabw'omurundi gwaheru.
answer_c: Nibarikanga kandi nibareeta ebicweka by’okubanza ebibasobozesa kwetantara n’okutebeekanisa okugyenda omu maisho n’omulimo. Ekyakurataho, nibakora okucwekyereza n’okushaka ebyevugo nk’ekitebeekaniso ky’okubanza, eki barikureeba, barikuhumuza, kandi barikugabana okukurikirana kuruga aha bagenzi baabo n’omwegyesa.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza omuririmbo ogu yaatooraine omwegyesa, nibashwijuma ebintu ebirikukora omuririmbo. Nibatebeekanisiza ebice by'omuririmbo ebirikushushana aha bintu byabo kandi bakagucwara, eki bakukoresa bwanyima kukora enshushani zaabo, nibakuratira embeera y'omuririmbo ogu barikukuratira.

question: Omugurusi omu omuri ক্লাসি y'abyeshuri ab'omwaka gwa kabiri omuishomero rikuru ateekanisa kukorera hamwe n'abyeshuri aha kwegyesa okuhurikiza n'okutaho omutima aha mitwarize y'ebyeshurirwe omu nyamumbo ezirikukundwa. Kandi okukora eki, omu ক্লাসি zimwe, abyeshuri baraahurikize enyamumbo ezitoroirwe kandi baahandiike omu kabooki kaabo ebicweka by'enyamumbo egi yoona (ekicweka ekikuru, ekicweka ekirikugarukwamu, ekicweka ekirikubaho omu nyamumbo, n'ebindi), ebicweka ebi ebirikwegaanirwaho nibiza kwegyesibwa omu myolesho erikukorwa. Bwegyesa ki bw'okuhurikiza obu abyeshuri bashemereire kuba baine obwengye bwokubwegyenda kwegyesa obusya?
answer_a: Hoolaanisa enjegyeka z'omuriro ogw'okwombeka ezirikwendaana
answer_b: Shisha ebitebyo by'omuriro ogurikukwata omutima
answer_c: Shuuruura ebicweka ebirikwijuka omu mweshongoro n'ebitarikwijuka.
answer_d: Manya emigaruro y'ebintu bibiri

question: Omuhiga omwegyesa omu ky'ekibiina kya 3 ekya secondary ateekanisa isomo aha bukuru bw'Afirika omu nyimbo z'Amerika. Nk'ekicweka ky'ebirikugambwaho, yaashoboorora ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: "Kwetegyereza enshonga z'enyimbo omu Amerika ahu obukuru bw'enyimbo za Afrika burikusiimwa." Omu mirimo egi abeeshuri baraakore, niki ekirikukwata aha kigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa eki kigambirwe?
answer_a: Geranisiza engyeshana z'enyimbi z'Abafirika n'enyimbi z'Abamapuche ezitari zimwe.
answer_b: Noonyereza ebintu ebirikwenda nk'ebicweka by'omubiri omu bwomeezi bw'abantu ab'omu bwire obutakahikire Abazungu omu America
answer_c: Shoborora ebiteego n'okuririmba omu rumba y'e Colombia
answer_d: Handiika emiringo y'ebitiinisa ebirikumanyisa Africa.

question:

answer_a: Omugyenda gw'okumarraho ekumi na ibiri
answer_b: Emikono y'ebicweka bikuru by'omuziki
answer_c: Ebirango ebimanyirwe omuri koodi ez'omutaano
answer_d: Okuhindura omu rurengo orutooraine rurikuru

question:
Omugyezibwa naakora omurimo gw'ekikundi. Omugyezibwa nayenda kukoresa ebikoreso bibiri by'okugyezesa. Ekikoreso ekya mbere nikikoresebwa omu muringo gw'okukora omurimo kworeka omutindo gw'okuhingura omurimo ogurikukorwa buri kikundi, n'ekikoreso kya kabiri nikikoresebwa aha muheru gw'omurimo kwongyera aha bwengye bw'abeeshuri aha kuza omu maisho kw'omurimo.
Omu biteekateeko ebi orikumanya, ekihe kya butoosha nikyo kirukworeka, omu muringo ogurikugyenda, ebikoreso by'okugyezesa ebirikukwata aha bigyendererwa by'omugyezibwa?
answer_a: Ebirango n'ekipimo ky'omuntu omwe
answer_b: Ekyererezo ky'ebyahandiikwa n'akabandi k'omutwe gw'ekibiina
answer_c: Ekiragiro ky'okushwijuma abandi hamwe n'eky'okukwata eby'okurorraho
answer_d: Omugisha gw'okusiima n'obuhabuzi bw'okweyesuura

question:
Omuhereza omu omwaka gw'ababili, omugyezibwa naareeba omulingo abegi abarikucwara ebintu by'omuziki barikukora. Ku barikuhika aha kicweka kya korasi, naareeba ngu abegi abarikucwara gitarri y'amashanyarazi tibarikubaasa kutegeka amaani g'omuziki gwabo, ekirikureetera endooliito nkuru erikucwarwa violin kutahurikika. Omugyezibwa acwamu kuha abegi eby'okubahabura aha ngyenderweso y'amaani g'omuziki.
Eki aha hansi nikikuruuga haihi n'okuha eby'okukonyera abegi?
answer_a: Omugyezaho: Omugureeki asaba abeeshuri kucweereza omuziki ogurikugira amaani agatari gamwe agari omuri ogwo omuziki batarikukoresa kantu, ahabw’okugweteegyereza n’okugweshomesa.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa naagambira abeeshuri ngu nikikuru omulinga gw'ekihumulo guhurirwa omu bintu ebindi byoona ebirikucweereza, reero abagambira kureeba obwingi bw'amajwi gaabyo.
answer_c: Omugyezaho naayijutsya abeeshure omuringo gw'amaani g'omuziki arikubaza kubashomesa oburemeezi bw'amaani agariho agubasobora kutunga aha bikoreso byabo by'omuziki.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naabuuza abeeshuri kumanya ekirikukwata omuryo ogurikukuruuta omukoro mukuru, kandi n'abashaba kuhindura amaani kurugiirira aha muryo ogwo.

question: Omuhiga omuriira ahaiguru omwaka gwa 3, omwegyesa ariho atekateeka ebicweka by’okwegyesa ebiri aha by’okuririmba eby’omuri obu bwiire. Ekigyendererwa kimwe ky’okwegyesa kye nikyo: “Kwetegyereza omu mutwe n’okuhurira ebiriho nibyombwa n’emitindo y’endirimbo.” Omu bintu ebiri ahansi, ekiheebwa ki ekirikworeka eky’okugyeragyerera ekirikugarukamu ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa ekyagambirweho?
answer_a: Kuhanga oruyo n'ebicweka bibiri: orucweka orubanza n'orucweka orurikukurira.
answer_b: Kutahoora ebicweka by'orurembo rw'orweshongoro orwa popu
answer_c: Orikwata omukuru gw'endengo y'ekicweka kya rondo erimu emitwe ebiri
answer_d: Kumanya ebimanyiso bikuru by'omuziki ogucweererwe kurahura.

question: Omuhwezi w’omu klasse y’ahaiguru omwaka gwa kabiri, omugyezaho naija kutandika kukora aha mutwe gw’okubumba ogurikwata aha misingye mikuru y’enyegyesa z’eby’obuhangwa ez’ekyasha kya makumi abiri ez’omulembe ogurikukura. Kandi okukora eki, omutwe nigutandika n’omurimo gw’okucwamu ebiragiro by’ekubo ly’okushushana eby’omulembe. Ni bumanyi ki abeeshuri bashemereire kuba baine okukora omurimo ogwo?
answer_a: Okwetegyereza ebintu omuhendo ogurikworeka okuhendera, ekirikukirira omu by'obuganga bya Renaissance
answer_b: Ekishushani ky'obubonero, ekirikwetengwa abahanga b'ekibiina kya Blue Rider
answer_c: Ekishushani ekirikworeka omuringo, ogurikukwata aha rurimi rw'ebishushani bya Byzantine
answer_d: Okuhukana n'okwolekwa kw'ebintu nk'oku abanyabwomeezi b'ekibiina kya Vienna Secession baakora.

question: Omu klasse y’ahaiguru omwaka ogw’abiri, omu mutwe gw’eky’okubanza "Okushushana Ebishushani", abeeshuri nibaija kutandika omurimo ogurikugira ekigyendererwa ky’okushushana eposta erikworeka okumanyisa abantu b’omu ishomero aha ky’okworeka eby’emikono ebirikwija. Twaba niturora ekyo, niki abeeshuri bashemereire kwetegyereza kubaasa kukora eposta egi eshabirwe?
answer_a: ebishushani, ekigambo eky'omugasho, akamanyiso
answer_b: Omwandiko, ekitabo, ekishushani
answer_c: Eby'okushushani, ebihandiiko, ebiri omunda
answer_d: Okutebeekanisa, empandiika y'ebigambo, ebishushani

question: Omuhingiiriza gw'amaisho g'eshagama gwine embaju y'okureeba ya 180◦ nari okukiraaho, nigugumisiriza ebishushani. Nk'eky'okureeberaho ki kuruga omu magara ga buri izooba eki omwegyesa araabe n'aha abegi kubaase kwetegyereza obuhangwa obu?
answer_a: Ekishushani ekirikwererekwa omu ndorerwamu ey'omunda nkumiire
