answer_c: Ekishushani ekirikureebwa omu ndeeberwamu omu kibya ky'amaizi
answer_d: Ekishushani ekirikureebwa omu ndebereza omu mwiko

question:
Omu omwegyesa omu mwaka gwa 3 ogw’ahaiguru omu ssomero, naatandika kukora n’abegyeswa be aha purojekiti y’okushushaniisa kuruga omu muringo gw’okwoleka ebi orikuteekateeka.
Ni bintu ki ebiri omu bintu ebi ebi omwegyesa arikubaasa kukoresa kureetera purojekiti kuruga omu muringo ogwo ogworekwa?
answer_a: Baza abaana ebiteekateeko nari emigasho ebi barikwenda kushushaniisa, kurugiirira aha baine omukago n'ebarikukunda, kubaasa kukora aha mirimo yaabo.
answer_b: Reeta ekishushani erikworeka omulingo omulungi ogurikubaasa kukoresibwa nk'entandikiro y'okukora omulimo, abeeshuli kubashe kugumara n'okukikoresa omu mirimo yaabo y'okushushana.
answer_c:
Gyenzi: Abegi abeegi, tukaganiire aha muringo gw'okushushaniisa ogu murikubaasa kukoresa omu mirimo yaanyu, okuhiga okwetaba, okucwekyereza, n'okugambirana ebi murikukunda. Noobaasa kuteera amagyezi aha muringo ogu orikukunda kushushaniisa?

Mugisha: Ninyenda kushushaniisa n'ebarafu, ahabw'okuba ninyenda kureeta omushana n'obweru omu kishushani kyange.

Gyenzi: Ekyo kirungi! Noobaasa kutugambira oku orikukikora?

Mugisha: Ninkoresa ebarafu nyingi, kandi ninteeka amazi mingi omu rangi yangye, n'okukoresa brushi erikwera.

Gyenzi: Murungi. Omundi, iwe orikukunda muringo ki?

Kemigisha: Ninyenda kukoresa omuringo gw'okusiiga rangi nyingi, ahabw'okuba ninyenda kureeta amaani n'omutima omu kishushani kyange.

Gyenzi: Ekyo kirungi! Noobaasa kutugambira oku orikukikora?

Kemigisha: Ninkoresa rangi nyingi, kandi ninkoresa brushi erikukwata, n'okusiiga rangi nyingi aha kishushani kyange.

Gyenzi: Murungi. Mureke tuganiire aha muringo ogu twena turikubaasa kukoresa omu mirimo yaitu. Turi kubasa kukoresa ebarafu kureeta omushana n'obweru, nari tukakoresa rangi nyingi kureeta amaani n'omutima. Eki kikuru n'okukoresa omuringo ogurikureeta ebi turikukunda. Mwine ebindi ebi murikwenda kugambaho?
answer_d: Teeka abegyesa okucuurura aha mukubi w'ebishushani ou baayenda, baronderere ebimanyiso by'ebishushani by'omurimo gwe, kwenda kubikoresa omu mirimo yaabo y'okukuba ebishushani.

question: Omuhiga omwegyesa omu ishomero erikuru erya kana, omuri omutwe "Okushwijuma Endimi z'Obwomeezi n'Ez'Eby'Ekemegyenga: Ebishushani bya Vidiyo", naija kukoragana n'abegyi aha mugingo gw'eisomo ogurikukurataho: kumanya emiringo erimuhendera y'omuringo ogu gw'okwoleka. Ebintu by'okwegyesa ebiri aha bwansi nibiriha ebirikubaasa kwikiriza omwegyesa kuhikiiriza omugingo gw'eisomo?
answer_a: Yoreka ebiragiro by'omurimo ogw'okubaka ekishushani kya Spiral Jetty, ekyakozirwe Robert Smithson.
answer_b: Reeba vidiyo z’ebikorwa bya Marina Abramovic hanyuma mushomeshe abeeshuri ebi murikureeba.
answer_c: Mureebe omulimo gw'eby'obuhangwa ogurikworekwa omu by'okureeba n'okuhurira ogwakozirwe Juan Downey, reero mugushwijume n'abeeshuri.
answer_d: Omuhanda gw'okumanya eby'afa Bill Viola n'emirimo ye

question: Omuhendo gw'omwegyesa ogw'okwegyesa abanywani b'omwaka ogw'abiri omuringo gw'okukora ebishushani n'omutego (stencil) n'okubikozesa omu murimo gwabo ogw'okwetengesa, arikukozesa ekitabo ekirikubegyesa omuringo ogwo. Omu myanya egi, niki ekirikubaasa kukozesebwa nk'ekikwaso ky'okwegyesa ekirikukwata aha mugasho ogwo?
answer_a: Ekicweka ky'ebishushani ekikozirwe kuraba omu kacuba
answer_b: Vidiyo erikukwata aha mitendekyere Keith Haring akakozesa omu mirimo ye
answer_c: Eby’ahandiikwa ebikwata aha murimo n’obuhangwa obukoresibwa omukubi w’ebishushani TAKI 183
answer_d: Okwegyesereza aha bikorwa by'abaranga omuhanda abakozesa omuringo gwa "wild style"

question: Omuheresi bwamara kushiima ebishushani by’omutindo ogurikumanyisa ebintu nk’oku birukushemerera, akagaruka aha byafaayo byabyo, n’okubyetegyereza, omwegyesa aha abaana be naija kubagira ati: “Murembe ebishushani nk’ebirikubahwera kwetegyereza, omu mureme omushushani ogurikworeka ebintu nk’oku birukushemerera, murondereho ekintu ekirikukuru, mushange n’omuhereza omwe ou mwareebire.” Eki nikikwatana na kyi aha mitendera y’omulingo ogurikwenda omuntu kuhanga?
answer_a: Hamu eky'okuhakanisa eky'obuhangwa
answer_b: Teekateekateeka kandi oyeshange ebirikukurabamu
answer_c: Tebeekanisa omurimo
answer_d: Ngyenda y'okubanza

question: Omu omukuru omu iraaya ry'okubanza (ahaiguru y'eishomero), kwongyera aha biteekateeko ebikwata aha by'okushushani, omwegyesa ayoreka ebishushani ebirikworeka emiringo n'ebicweka by'ebishushani ebirikutaana. Bwanyima y'okureeba n'okushwijuma ebishushani, abuuza abeeshuri kukora aha biteekateeko omu kubahoza ebishushani omu myanya erikutaana omu ishomerero. Omurimo ogu nigwija kushwijumwa omu muringo gw'okubanza kurugiirira aha kipimo ky'okushwijuma. Twaba niturora omurimo ogu guhaiirwe, ni birikukurataho byona ebiriho ebirikukwataana n'okutwara omu kikoreso?
answer_a: Nibakoresa emiringo n'obureezi bw'omutwe omu bintu ebi barikwenda kworeka.
answer_b: Nibarikira emyanya n'ebizingo omu myombeko y'eishomero
answer_c: Nibakoresa emiringo n'obugazi obutari bumwe omu bifaananyi byabo
answer_d: Nibarikiriza amoko g'emyesho n'ebicweka by'okukoresa omu kubamba ebishushani byabo.

question:
Omuhereza omu omwaka gwa kana omuishomero erikuru, omugyezibwa naakora aha mutindo gw'ebishushani gwa Edvard Munch. Kureetera abegi be kumanya ebirikukwata aha nshonga egi, naabashaba kukora ekishushani ekirikugambira aha nshonga egi, ekiraashomerwa kurugiirira aha rutondeka rw'ebintu ebirikugyezibwa.
Ni enki aha biteekateeko ebi erimu ekirikukwata aha kuteekwa omu rutondeka rw'ebirikugyezibwa?
answer_a: N'akoresa ebintu ebirikureetera ebaraara kureeta ebishushani ebirikworeka omuringo gw'ahantu.
answer_b: Nokukoresa emibara y'amaani kandi etarikucampururwa kugumisaho ebitebyo
answer_c: Nekukoresa enyegyesere n'ekiziizi kureeta obwingi
answer_d: N'okukoresa ekishushani n'enyima kukora obuhangame bw'omu bwengye

question: Omuhwezi omu Nursery, naija kukurata omugasho gw’okwegyesa: “Kworeka okusiima ebintu ebirimu obunaku, okugarukamu kuraba omu miringo etari emwe n’emwe, nk’okugamba, ebigyendereirwe, okuseka, n’ebindi”, kuruga omu mutima gw’Endimi z’Obuhangwa. Okukora eki, abaasha omu kicweka eky’okwegyesa, abata omu rwarwa ebintu ebirikushushana ebirimu obunaku obutari bumwe n’obumwe, abaana babishomere. Hanyuma y’obwire bukye, omwana ashoma eky’okukoresa kandi atandika kugarukamu. Omuhwezi naija haihi kandi yeeshusha omwana. Kurugiirira aha mbeera erikugambwaho, niki eki omuhwezi araakore ekirikubaasa kwanguhya okuhikiiriza omugasho ogu?
answer_a: “Eky’obusingye ki orikukwata aha kibumbiro eki? Eki nikyorobi, eki nikikakara. Niki eki orikwenda kutwara?”
answer_b: Orikukunda ebyo nakuhaire? Nooyenda kukwata ekindi? Noobaasa kukishangaho? Ndaakikureetere haihi.
answer_c: "Orikukwata aha bbulooka ezirikwata omu mikono, okuseka kwaawe nikundeetera kumanya ngu nooyenda ekirikwata omu mikono ekyorobi. Eyi nekalakala, nooyenda kukikwataho?"
answer_d: "Orikukwata aha bbulooka ezirikwata omu mikono, nozikunda? Noyenda kukwata endiijo? Gyotore n'engaro zaawe. Otarukire, nungi muno!"

question: Omwegyesi w’eisomero ry’abaana abato naija kukora aha mugingo gw’okwega: “Kushoboorora enyimba, arikukozesa ebintu ebirikushangwa nk’eiraka, omubiri, ebintu by’okucuranga, n’ebintu ebindi,” kuruga omu mutwe gw’Enimi z’Obuhangwa. Ni murimo ki ogurikworekwa abaana oguraayoreke ngu batungire omugingo ogu gw’okwega?
answer_a: Kukora omuhendo gw'omubiri nigukurata omwiherero gw'omuziki
answer_b: Okuzina orukuzinira hamwe n'okukora ebikye hamwe n'okwetegyereza omutindo gw'omuziki
answer_c: Teeranira omutima hamwe nokukoresa ebintu by'omuziki ebirikushushana
answer_d: Okweshongora enyembo ezirikushushana, orikukomera hamwe n'okuhindura omutwe kurugiirira aha muringo gw'enyembo.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omuisha w’abaana abato naayenda kukurata aha kiragiro ky’okwegyesa ekirikukurataho n’abaana bato: “Kugamba ebi barikuteekateeka n’okuhurira kwabo aha bikorwa by’obugangaana ebirikushushana.” Kutiya kukora eki, naabayita kureeba eby’okuranga eby’obugangaana ebirimu ebishushani by’ebikorwa by’abahanga abarikuruga omu nsi yoona. Obu barikutaayaayira eby’okuranga, nibareeba buli kishushani ekikumanyirwe. Pedro naareeba n’obwegendereza ekikorwa “Okuguta.” Omwegyesa naamwijukira yaamubuuza: “Niki orikureeba omu kishushani eki?” Omwana naagarukamu: “Omushaija orikuguta.” Ni ki aha bigambo ebirikukurataho eki omwegyesa araabe asaasiize Pedro kumuhereza eby’okugarukamu aha kugarukamu kwe n’okuhiga kukuratira ekiragiro ky’okwegyesa eki kirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Omurimo ogu nigwetwa "Okugutaama" kandi nigwo mukuru kuruga omu by'omukoro by'omuhangi ogu. Noora ota ahabw'enki yaashushaniize omushaija agutaama? Omushaija ogwo naaba ari oha?
answer_b: Noogyezire omulimo ogu? Niki ekirikukuraho amaisho? Ahabw'enki omushaija arikutaaka? Ekishushani nikyetwa "Okutaaka" kandi buzima nikyoreka omushaija arikutaaka.
answer_c: Omurimo ogu nigwetwa “Okuguta” kandi gukakolebwa omukolezi w’ebishushani omunya Norway orikwetwa Edvard Munch. Mirongo ki eyoraaba omu kishushani? Marangi ki aganza kureebwa? Bintu ki ebindi ebyoraaba omu kishushani?
answer_d: Niki ekirikureetera okuteekateeka ngu omushaija ariyo naataata? Nooteekateeka ngu niki ekirikumugwaho? Noohurira ota waareeba omurimo ogu? Ekishushani nikyetwa "Okutaata" kandi kikakorerwa omushushani omunya-Norway owaayetwa Edvard Munch.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa pule-iscuuli orikukora n’abaana abato abakuzire naija kutebeekanisa ebintu ebirikukora omu bwire bw’ekibiina ekikuru, arikukuriza ekigyendererwa ky’okwega ekirikukurira omu kicweka ky’endaimi z’obuhangwa: “Kutoorana ebikozirwe, okwehindura, n’ebihuriirwa kuruga omu butonde bwabo obw’omugasho, kuraba omu miringo etari emwe.” Ni engyeso ki aha zirikukurira ezirikukiriza okugyenda aha kigyendererwa ekigambirwe?
answer_a: Ha abaana omugani, reero obagambire bakore eky'okwijwara omu mutwe ekya munywani ou baakundire munonga.
answer_b: Baana mubeeshwe ebirangi by'enyamaishwa ebirikukozesa ebirangi byazo, reero mubagambire kubimanya omu kubeta omuriro gwazo.
answer_c: Mureke abaana bazane omuzano "Simooni Agamba" kandi murage, kuraba omu by'okuragira, ebintu ebirikushangwa ebi baine kushaka n'okureeta.
answer_d: Mureke abaana barimbe kandi bazine enyimbo ezirikugyenda n'okukora ebintu ebirikworekwa, nk'enyimbo "Okwenda omu rurengo rw'Engena" na "Ekihangahanga ky'omu Kyanzigwa."

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekicweka kya kindergarten ateekanize ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa ekirikuruga omu mutima gw’endimi z’eby’obuhangwa: “Okugaragaza omu bwengye eby’okukora ebiteekateeko, ebirooto, ebyahwireho, n’ebirikukiraho, kuraba omu mirongo, emiringo, amarangi, n’obusingye, n’ebikoreso n’obuhwezi omu mwanya n’obunene.” Okuhikiiriza eki, baryakuzaho n’ekibiina kyabo omurimo ogurikwetwa “Okuhanga ekifukuzi”, nibahandiika omulingo abaana barikukora kuraba omu bifaananyi. Omu mulingo ki ogurikukurataho ogurikugwisa omwegyesa kwombeka obuhame ahakukora kw’ekigyendererwa ekiteekateekirwe?
answer_a: Yoreka abaana ebishushani ebirikukwata aha nyamaishwa, reero obagambire bagambe ebi barikuhurira. Bwanyima obagambire batoore kimwe kukiikirira.
answer_b: Mureke abana mubehemu eby'okuhinduramu eby'enfuuko eshatu, barondemu kimwe, babihindure bakoresa ebintu ebirikubaasa kugarurwa. Bwanyima mubagambire kworeka ab'eka yaabo emiringo ei bakozeseze kukora ekintu eki.
answer_c: Hanga abaana ebintu bitari bimwe, otebeze kwihamu ebimwe bashobore kukora ekishushani ky'ekifuyo. Bwanyima, obete kwolesa banywani baabo omu ishomero ahabw'enki eki kifuyo kyabo kyorobiire.
answer_d: Mureke abaana bareebe vidiyo erikushoboorora emitendera y'oku kuronda omuhanda gw'okukora ekishushani ky'ekifuyo. Bwanyima, mubateekateeke ekiganiro ky'eby'obuganga omwo bareebye ebi bakozire omuhanda gw'okukora ekishushani ky'ekifuyo. Bwanyima, mubateekateeke ekiganiro ky'eby'obuganga omwo bareebye ebi bakozire omu bantu boona.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omuto n’omushomo “Enyegyeserezo ezindimu omunda”. Omushomo ogu nigwo gutwariramu ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa kuruga omu mutima gw’orurimi rw’obuhangwa: “Okwoleka enyegyeserezo, ebiteekateeko, n’ebyarabiremu kuraba omu by’obuhangwa omu kwetegyereza eby’okushushana, eby’okuhandiika, n’eby’okubumba”. Omu mushomo gwona, bakozire ebintu bitari bimwe kandi, okumaliriza, omwegyesa naayeta abaana kwolesa ebi bakozire omu mushomo ogu. Martina arikwoleka omulimo gwe, nagira ati: “Nkoreire obupiira bubiri, omwe gwa kyenvu n’omundi gwa kiragura, ahabw’okuba nizo rangi ezindikunda munonga”. Omwegyesa nabuuza: “Ekishushani kyaawe nikyoleka enyegyeserezo ki?”. Martina naagarukamu: “Timanyire”. Okuha omu by’okukora kw’omwegyesa okurikukurataho nikikuru okuhwera Martina kutunga ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa?
answer_a: Murungi, Martina! Nindora omurimo gwaawe nigwo mizaano y'ebitunguru by'amabara. Nooyenda kukuzaana n'ebitunguru? Ahabw'enki ekitunguru kimwe kiri kibisi ekindi kiri kiragura? Nibakwijutsya aha biteekateeko byona?
answer_b: Murungi, Martina! Emitwe ei waahangire eri omu ibara eiturikukoresa kumanyisa ebi twenaaba nitwenda. Ekyerobeka nikimanyisa obuteeka, n'eikumi nikimanyisa okushemererwa.
answer_c: Murungi weebale, Martina! Otoraine amarangiri gaawe ag'okukunda munonga omu murimo gwaawe. Noobaasa kumbuza ahabwenki washushaniize ebipinga? Noohurira ota n'amarangiri g'omubisi gw'omuti n'obuhondo? Ahabwenki gari amarangiri gaawe ag'okukunda munonga?
answer_d: Murungi otyo, Martina! Kwonka noobaasa kuhikiiriza omurimo gwaawe orikwijuka ngu oshemereire kwohereza ebimwe aha byahwiremu n'enyegyesereza? Nobaasa kuba okushemererwa kw'okuzaana omupiira n'abanywani baawe nari obusaasi obu orikubuza omupiira.

question: Omuhwezi w’ekicweka kya 5 omuishomero, omugabe naija kwegyesa ekigyendererwa eki: "Kuhimba n’okuhanga ebicweka by’omuziki n’ekigyendererwa ekirikugambwaho n’obuhangwa oburikukwata aha rurimi rw’omuziki." Kucungura eki, naija kushaba abegi kuhimba emiringo y’okutooraana ey’omuziki, nibakoresa ebintu ebirikukubisa. Murimo ki ogurikukwata aha kucungura ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Omugyezaho ahandiika emiringo y’ebitiinisa etari emwe omu kaabale abeeshuri kuza kumutooroora bwanyima bagihindure omu kweshushuuriza kwabo aha rurengo rw’enyimba ezi bashemereire kuheerezaana nazo.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa naayoreka ebirangi by'omuziki gwa Afro omu class. Obwo abuuze abeeshuri kukoresa ebi biteekateeko byabo omu kweshushura kandi babikorese omu rurengo orurikugambwaho.
answer_c: Omugyezibwa naabuuza abeeshuri kuhurikiza omuryo gw'ebicurangiro kandi naayoreka engyenderwaho ez'omutaano n'ebintu by'omuranga ebirikushushana. Reero naabashaba kubiigana omu muringo gw'omutindo.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naabuuza abeeshuri kuhurikiza endyaito y'ebicurangiro n'okucuranga emiringo etari emwe emwe ey'omusingi gw'ebicurangiro. Obwo naashobora oruraza rw'omuringo gw'ebicurangiro n'abeeshuri, naronda rondana okuhindurana kwabo okw'obwengye.

question: Abeshomesha abegi baine kuba baine obumanyi ki okutandika kwega Harmony?
answer_a: Ebirinzi
answer_b: Ebirango by'omutindo
answer_c: Emikorwa mikuru
answer_d: Emizani mikuru n'emito

question: Omuhwezi omu mwaka gwa mushanju, omu rukurato rw'ebicurangiro, omugyezaho abaire naakora aha kwetegyereza orutondekwa rw'amaraka abiri n'ebicurangiro ebirikuhereekereza. Abeegi, omu bibinja, bakashuuruura oku barikwetegyereza ekicweka nibarikwetegyereza ebiragiro by'obuhangwa obuhikire, obuhangwa oburikukwatanisa n'obuhangwa oburikuruga omu mutima, hamwe n'okukoresa gye obugabe bw'okushoborora n'obuhanga bw'ebicurangiro. Aha muheru gw'okushuuruura, omugyezaho akashanga ekibinja ky'abeegi kimwe nikikora enshobi z'obwire omu bifaananyi bimwe, nibakora orutindo omu mwanya gw'okukwatanisa obwire obu birikworeka omu rupapura. Ni nshoborozi ki erikukwata aha kutooroza erikuruga ahari omugyezaho eririkubaasa kushobooza abeegi kusingura enshobi n'okuhikiiriza ebiragiro ebiriteirweho ahabw'okwetegyereza ekicweka?
answer_a: Tikirikushobora kureeba ngu niboongyeire omuringo ogu barikucwara omuziki; kwonka, obutoosha hariho omugisha gw’okuhikiiriza omu ku shoma enyangi z’omuziki. Ni enshonga ki ey’okushoboorora enyangi z’omuziki egi orikureeba nk’erihoobu?
answer_b: Ninkusiima ahabw'okukora omurimo gw'okucweereza orurembo rw'ebicurangiro omu muringo ogurikwenda. Okukuraho, ninkweta kworeka amatwi aha kadiyo y'orurembo, orikwata aha muringo n'obuhanga bw'omucweereza, ebi bikyaine kuboneza.
answer_c: Omu kubuurira, ohikire aha bunyakare bw'amaani bw'okuta omutima aha kintu, tukusiima! Aha bikwaata ku muringo gw'okucurra, nikyetaagisa kukora omuhendo gw'okucurra kw'amahe g'omuringa oguhendera hamwe.
answer_d: Obuhangwa bw’omuziki n’obuhikire bw’ebicurangiro by’omuziki byahika aha mutindo murungi ogw’okushoboorora. Aha bikwaata aha muhendo, noobaasa kushuuruura ebice bya buri kaanya ebi birikworekwa omu rupapura rw’omuziki n’eki waakozeseze omu kushoboorora kwaawe?

question: Omwegyesereza n'eklassi y'omunaana omu omutwe gw'okuhurikiza, okwimba, n'okucwara. Hanyuma, naija kucungura ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: "Kushoborora enyimba ezirikukwatana n'omuziki oguhurikiziibwe; okukiraho kwikiriza okukura kw'obureezi bw'okugamba n'amaani". Ni kirorro kyeki ekirikworeka okuhikiirira kw'okwegyesa oku?
answer_a: Nibarikira kandi bagamba nibashomesereza aha kutandika n'okuhendera kw'omurimo, nibagushoboorora n'obwengye bw'ebicurangiro.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza kuririmba n'okucuranga omu mairu agari omuri rimwe, nibateekateeka aha muringo gw'omutindo gw'omurimo n'engira yaagwo
answer_c: Nibarikira kandi bagamba ebirango nibakora engyekyerane erikuhikaana n'omuringo gw'omulimo ogurikushobororwa.
answer_d: Nibarikira kandi bagamba nibakoresa emyehe n'ebirikugumya amaani omu murimo ogurikushoboororwa.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’eky’omukaaga naashuuruura abegyegwa be aha bigyendererwa by’okwega ebi: "Kumanya emitwarize y’enyimba ezirikukwata aha mizaanzi ya Chile eya ira n’omutaano gwazo ogurikukwata aha kicweka ky’ihanga eki zirimu". Ni bukugu ki oburikwija kworeka ngu abegyegwa bakuruhiire ebigyendererwa by’okwega?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza omurongo gw'emizino ya kiraabu kuruga omu bitundu ebihendaine by'eihanga, nibakoresa ebintu n'amajwi gaabo.
answer_b: Nibarikira omuhanda gw'abantu n'enyimba ezimanyirwe ez'emizino ya Chile eya ira eyi bazi, kandi nibaziteekanisa kurugiirira aha muringo gwazo ogurikukirayo.
answer_c: Nibakora ekiikaro kya Chile omubarikweterera ebintu byabo ebikoresebwa omu kuhaana n'emizino yabo ey'obuhangwa omu bitundu byabo eby'omubugye bw'eihanga.
answer_d: Nibahurira ebiragiro by’omuziki ogurikuruga omu mbyino za Chile ez’obuhangwa ez’omutindo ogurikushushana kandi nibazitebeekateeka kurugiirira aha kicweka ky’ensi, okurikurugiira aha bikoresho ebirikukoresibwa n’omuringo gw’okucuranga ogurikusingura.

question: Omuhendiisa omu ky'eshomero ry'omwaka ogwa 7, omu mutwe gw'ebyetengo by'okutega ebishushani, nayegyesa abegi be aha bintu ebikuru ebiranga orurimi rw'ebishushani. Yaheza kushoborra omu magambo nari okuraba omu kubanza ebishushani ebiteekateeko by'ebicweka, emiringo, n'okuta omutima aha kintu kimwe, namushaba abegi kutega ebishushani omu kibanja ky'eshomero, nibakoresa emiringo etari emwe eyayegererwe. Obu arikurora omulingo ogu kigyendoiremu, omuhendiisa akagwamu ngu omu bishushani bingi, abegi bakakoresa obucweka butari bumwe obutakozese emiringo, nukwo kirukworeka ngu nibabuzya obucweka n'omulingo gw'okutega ebishushani. Aha mirimo erikukurataho, niki omuhendiisa arikubaasa kushaba abegi kushoborra ebiteekateeko by'emiringo omu mulingo ogurikukora?
answer_a: Taaha ebishushani by'omunywani waawe orikwegyera n'oora yaaho omu roomu omu bihendera ebirikutaana, okuhitsya obu oriba omuri mita emwe kumwegyera haihi.
answer_b: Reeba omu magaziini oreebe ebishushani ebirikworeka emiringo n'engyeso ez'enjawulo, reero obigaragaze orikubaasa kushushana ekintu ky'oyihire omu kicweka ky'eishomero eki orikukunda.
answer_c: Yoreeta ebishushani by'akakoomera k'ekaramu aha meza y'endiro, oteeka kamera ahaiguru y'ekintu orikwemerera aha ntebe reero oteeke ahansi yaakyo oryamire aha itaka
answer_d: Gyezaho amafoto g'akajega aha meza eyaba eri hagati omu kicweka, orikuruga omu bice by'omuringo ogushushaniirweho aha itaka okurikugiingizya akajega ako.

question: Omu klasa y'omwaka ogw'omukaaga, omu mutwe gw'okubaza n'endala engyenderwaho z'okucapira, abegyi nibaija kukora ekishushani ky'ekintu ekirikushushana aha rupapura rw'omutanda gw'okucapira. Ngyenderwaho ki abegyi bashemereire kumanya kare kubaasa kukora omurimo ogwo?
answer_a: Okubaa omuti
answer_b: Omutwe gw'ekishushani
answer_c: Monotype
answer_d: Okuteera ebishushani hamu

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'omu mwaka ogwa 7, omu mutwe ogurikugamba "Okuhanga Ebirikureebwa, Omuntu n'Obutonde", ari kukorera hamwe n'abegyi be aha bintu bikuru ebirikumanyisa "land art", kurugiirira aha kureeba n'okushwijuma emirimo y'abahanga abarikukiikirira. Hanyuma, nashaba kukoresa eki baayegire omu purojekiti y'okutegyeka ekibanja omu ppaaka eri haihi n'eishomero n'okutwara ebifaananyi by'omurimo gw'obuhangwa. Omwegyesa naija kushwijuma ebirugiremu kuraba omu kipimo ky'okusiima. Kwegyera obuhame aha by'abegyi be barikukuratira, niki ekirikubaasa kworekwa omwegyesa kurugiirira omu kikoreso ky'okushwijuma?
answer_a: Nibakora ekitabo ky'ebifaananyi ekirikwoleka omulingo omulimo gw'obuhangwa gukolebwemu hamu n'ebyalugyemu eby'ahaheru.
answer_b: Nibarikayo kutoorana ebintu byobutonde nari ebiriho byenyine omu mutwe gwabo, omu kwikirizana n'emikorere y'eby'obuhangwa omu by'obuganga.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza omukago hagati y'obuntu bw'ensi ahu bashanga emirimo yaabo n'ekigyendererwa ky'okushoborora eki barikwenda kumanyisa.
answer_d: Nibarikukoresa ebintu ebirikureebwa omu bintu ebirikugaragaza ebikorwa by'obuhangwa bw'ensi kugira ngu babaze ebishushani byabo batakahangire omulimo ogwo.

question: Omugyezibwa omwegyesa omu mwaka gw'okubanza omuishomero erikuru ari kukora omurimo gw'okuririmba, okukiraho ekangyane omu bwihuri bw'amaraka ashatu. Ku yaheza kushoborora omuringo ogu gw'okucweera, areeba ngu abegyi be tibarikugwetegyereza gye, n'ahabw'ekyo yateekateeka kukoresa akarorero k'okubahwera kwetegyereza. Ni enyegyesereza ki aha zirikukurataho erikworeka orugero orurikukwatanisa gye okuhwera abegyi kwetegyereza okucweera omu kangyane y'obwihuri?
answer_a: Teekateekateeke omugani gw'okwiruka ogurikukozesebwa kandi akati nikahiirwa omweziruki munne omu kasumi kenyine, reero nikahiirwa omundi aha biro ebirikumanywa. Nikwo kiri n'enyimba y'okuririmba.
answer_b: Teekateeka abantu bashatu nibo nibarikweshongora ebirooto bitaani omu kasumi kamwe kandi omu muhendo gumwe, nibahikiirizana kandi nibahweraana, nibareeta amakuru mahyaka aha kiirikushomwa. Omu by'okuririmba, ebiirikushomwa bishemereire kutaangwa enyimbo ezirikuririmbwa.
answer_c: Teekateera ebintu nk'ebirikwenda omuziki bingi ebirikukwata orurembo rumwe, reero waaba nooyenda okucwera omuri buri kimwe omuhendo gw'ebitiina bimwe. Omu mbeera y'orurembo orurikwembwa, buri kimwe aha byo nikibaasa kuba ekibiina ky'abayimbi.
answer_d: Teekateekate omuhanda gw'ekishushani ogutandika n'omurongo gw'ebara rimwe kuruga aha kutandika kw'empapura, reero, obuhendo bukye ahariho, omurongo ogundi gw'ebara erikutaani gwaba gushushaniirwe, n'ebindi. Emirongo y'amabara neeba neeyo enyimbo ezishemereire kwembwa kandi sentimita z'obutaano neeba obwire bw'okurindira.

question: Omu omwegi omu omuri ক্লাসে ya P3, abegi nibakora ebintu ebirukukwatana n'okuhangahanga, nk'oku omwegyesa w'eisomo abagambire kuhanga orurembo orutari rureingwa rw'ebicurangiro. Omwegi omwe takamanya amakurru g'ekyo barukukora kandi abuuza omwegyesa kumushoborra n'ebigambo ebirukworobi kurora omurembo orutari rureingwa rw'ebicurangiro gurimu ki. Omu ebiri ahansi, niki ekirikwoleka eky'okugarukamu ekirikukwata aha tekiniki kuruga ahari omwegyesa ekirikukoresa orurimi orurikwetegerezebwa omwegi?
answer_a: Ni okuhanga omurongo gw'ebyahandiikwa ebirikugarukamu ebiragiro ebihairwe ekikuru nari etoni
answer_b: Ni kuta omuririmbi kuruga hamwe n’okugaruka omu bwijwire bw’okuririmba kuruga aha noti enkuru.
answer_c: Ni okukora omulimo omu muringo gw'okucuranga ogurateirweho, kurugiirira aha biteekateeko by'omusingi gw'enyimba, hamwe n'okukoresa obumwe bw'amalaka omu muringo ogurikukwatanisa.
answer_d: N’okukora omuziki kurabira omu miringo n’ebikoreso by’okuhimba ebiteekateekirwe.

question: Omugyezibwa w’ekibiina ky’abanywani abali omu mwaka ogw’obushatu omuishomero ly’ahaiguru ali omu muringo gw’okutebeekanisiza abegi be okuririmba omuziki gw’omurongo. Omu kicweka kimwe ky’orurimbo, abegi bashemereire kukoresa amaani g’okuririmba g’ahaiguru; kwonka, obu barikuririmba, nibenda kukora orurimbo orutari rurengire obu barikuririmba. Nkoreki omugyezibwa arikubaasa kukora okuhwera abegi kumanya orurimbo barikukora batarikuhindura obwangu bw’okuririmba?
answer_a: Shaba abeegi bakore omulimo n'amaani agutahinduka, nukwo bashobore kushuuruura ebirivaamu n'amaani agakorize kurungi.
answer_b: Leeta eky'okureetera abeeshuri orurembo orw'omurimo ogukozirwe ekwaya erikumanyirwa, nukwo barikwija kuhurira ebirugiremu eby'aha muheru kandi bashobore kutooroora omutaano ahari amaani g'omuriro gushemereire kucwekyerezibwa.
answer_c: Shoborora ebiriisa bya dynamics na agogics omuhendo gwabyo gwona, okukozesa emiringo etari emwe hamu omurimo, abegyesa bashobole kutaana omuhendo gwa buri kirisa.
answer_d: Shaba abeshomesha kukora myitooro y'amajwi, kwetegyereza obushoboorozi bwabo obw'amaani, ahabw'okwongyera obushoboorozi bwabo aha kipimo ky'amaani omu kworeka kwabo.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa klasse ya 2 ey’ahaiguru nagamba aha kushoma amanota g’ekikundi ky’ebicurangiro ebirimu obukundi bw’emiringo y’omutindo ogurikuruga omu kyakwaro ya noti ikumi na mukaaga. Abeegi niboreka oburemeezi omu kushoma n’okukora gye emiringo ya galopu n’okukyusa obucureezi, hamwe n’okukwatanisa n’okukuba emirundi eshatu. Omu mirimo egi erikuza kukwasa omu kucumura ekizibu ky’okushoma omutindo n’abeegi n’okwongyera aha bushobozi bw’okutwara okwega omu mbeera ezindi?
answer_a: Gambira abeshomesa kubara omu ijwi erirangurura ebicweka bya noti ikumi na mukaaga omu mutindo ogutindire, nibakoma obuteeka okuhitsya obu barikumanya obureingwa bwa buri kishushani.
answer_b: Kukora emizaano y'ebigambo n'enyigisho eyorobera entindo ezirikwata omutima, abeeshuri bashobore kukwatana n'okwijuka omu bwengye kandi batungye obuhangwa oburikukiraho omu kuhikiiriza ebishushani by'entindo ezo.
answer_c: Bangiira omugano n'okugabura omuzingo kuraba omuhendo, abeeshuri nibwo bakubeeka enyima ezirikukora omurimo gwangye n'ebikoreso byabo, okuhitsya obu barikubaasa kuzimanya gye.
answer_d: Teeka omugani gw'okwejuna omuhendo ogurikukwata omutima, abeeshuri bakwate omutima n'omukono gumwe n'ebishushani by'omuheeso ebizibu n'ogundi, okuhitsya obu barikubaasa kubihurirana.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogwa kabiri owa siniya ayenda kushomesa ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: “Kushoborora engyeso ezitari zimwe ez’amajwi gamwe rundi agarikukira ahamu, n’obwengye bw’omuringo, okukoresa oburyo bw’okureetera n’okutambuza omu kwegendereza n’okutambuza omurimo gwabo gw’ebicurangiro.” Ni mugisha ki ogw’omwegi ogurikworeka okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Nibakoresa emikoreso erikumanyirwa n'etarikumanyirwa, ebiriho omuhendo, ebiteekateeko by'omukono, n'ebindi bingi omu kworeka kwabo okw'ebicurangi, okurikurugiira aha bwetaazi bwabo n'ebirikubashemeza.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza n'okuhanga n'omuranga kuruga omu bintu ebirikushushana, embeera nari ebiteekateeko, niboreeka obwengye n'obuhangwa omu kukoresa ebirikukoresibwa.
answer_c: Nibarikira omu kuha ebirango birungi aha miko yabo n'eya banywani baabo omu by'omuziki, nibateekateeka aha bintu nk'obwangu, obuhangwa, okwejumbura, n'ebindi.
answer_d: Nibarikira omu muringo ogutari gumwe ogw'okukwata ebirangi n'okubyambukya, okurikurugaana n'ebirikukwata aha muziki ogurikukoresibwa n'obwire obu byabereireho.

question: Omugyezibwa w’ekibiina ky’abanywani abari omu mwaka ogw’okushatu omuishomero rikuru ataho ekigyendererwa ky’abanywani kweyongyera kumanya emishango n’obuhangwa bw’enyimbi, obwengye obuhikire, n’obucureezi. Ahabw’ekyo, atoorana orunywani rw’enyimbi rwa mirundi ena okucuurwa abanywani boona. Omu kuhingura, areeba ngu obu barikucuuraho n’obucureezi kandi nibamanya obuhangwa bw’orunywani obu barikurucuuraho, tibarikwatura ebigambo omu muringo oguhikire obu barikucuuraho, ahabw’ekyo, obwengye obuhikire tiburikukorwa. Ni ki eki omugyezibwa araakugambe, nk’omuringo gw’okuhabura, ekiraahwere abanywani kwega?
answer_a: Obwengye bw'okushoborora burungi ahabw'emitwarize y'omurimo. Kwonka, omu bweshongoro bw'amajwi, nikikuru ngu ebyahandiikirwe birikukwatana n'omuringo gw'ebicurangiro, n'ahabw'ekyo nibaija kubaasa kushuuruura ebi bintu byombi hamwe.
answer_b: Ninkusiima ahabw'okushoborora gye ekitabo eki. Hati, kikuru ngu, obu murikushoborora omuziki omu maraka, abairbi bateere ahari omwe n'omwe kugira ngu bahikiirize okugambira hamwe kurungi.
answer_c: Orikukozesa gye okakora; kwonka hakiriho obusaasi bw'okutunguura omu kuhamya ebirikukorwa. Okuhameza obuhinduzi obuhikire bw'ebyahandiikwa, ninshaba oreebe obundi okushoma kw'omutaano emirundi mingi.
answer_d: Obuhangwa burungi munonga n'okushoborora omulimo. Kwonka, okumaliiriza omulingo, nikikuru kwongyera amaani aha mishooro y'ebigambo omu kwimba. Eki kiyamba kwetegyereza amakuru gaabyo n'okuhikiiriza omu kwimba.

question: Kutandika omutwe Design and Dissemination, omu klasse ey'omwaka ogw'abiri omutendesi akora okusomesa okw'okubanza okushobora kumanya omulingo abegi barikwetwara omu by'okushushana n'amatabi gaakwo agasheeneene. Bwanyima y'okukora okusomesa okwo, omutendesi amanya ngu baine okwetenga okutali kwesigwa aha by'okushushana eby'amakuru, ahabw'okuba nibabihuriira nk'okukora eby'ebintu by'amakuru bingi. Murimo ki omutendesi araabe asobora kuteeka abegi omu, nukwo bashobore kwetegyereza eby'okushushana eby'amakuru?
answer_a: Reeba ebintu ebiragyiirwe omu by'okukora ebintu by'omunganda, oroorere, obishoboorore, obiteekyeteekye omu mitwaro, kandi okore ebishushani by'ebyo ebiragyiirwe.
answer_b: Roorana eby'okubanza eby'ebishushani ebirukusangwa omu klasiruumu kwetegyereza obutandwa bwabyo, okuhendera kwabyo, n'omukago gwabyo n'oburyo byakozirwemu.
answer_c: Sharaaza ekintu ky'ebigyenderwaza by'amakolero orikukoresa ebifaananyi, ahabw'ekigyendererwa ky'okuhanga ekintu kisya ekirikukora aha byetengo by'obunaku obu
answer_d: Noona ebintu by'okushushana eby'amaani ebyabaireho omu byafaayo by'okushushana ebintu by'amakolero, kwongyera okukora ekintu ekishushaine orikurora aha byetengo by'embeera.

question: Omugyezibwa omu omuri ক্লাসি y'abeeshumi ababiri omu mwaka gwabo ogw'okubiri naija kukorera hamwe n'abeeshumi be aha kicweka ky'Oburemeezi bw'embeera z'abantu omu By'okureeba, arikukura ekigyendererwa eki: "Kucweramu ebirungi n'ebibi by'ebikorwa ebirikwohereza oburemeezi bw'embeera z'abantu, kurugiirira aha kucweera omu by'okubonabona n'ebintu ebirikukoresibwa n'omubazi gw'ebikorwa." Kutiina kugyenda aha kigyendererwa eki, naija kubasaba kukora ekishushani kurugiirira aha mutwe ogu. Nkoreki y'emirimo erikukiriza kugyenda aha kigyendererwa ky'okwega eki?
answer_a: Shwijuma omuko gw'ekishushani eky'omulembe ogu, oronde enshonga nkuru, kandi oyombeke ekishushani orikuruga aha nshonga emwe ahariizo.
answer_b: Yombeka ekishushani ekirikukurira omu buringaniza bw'oburemeezi bw'abantu, shungura eky'oragizire n'omunywani waawe, reero okore ekishushani kurugiirira aha kushungura oku.
answer_c: Mbwenu handiika omwandiko ogurikukwata aha kwolekwa kw'ebizibu by'embeera z'abantu omu by'obuhangwa bw'okureeba, okombekanisize ebirowoozo ebirikukwataho kuruga omu bihandiiko, reero ohingure ekishushani ekirikuruga omu mwandiko ogwo.
answer_d: Noondi ebishushani ebirikukwata aha mutwe gw'enshonga, ohamye akakwate akari hagati y'ebintu by'orurimi rw'okureeba n'ekigyendererwa ky'okushoborora ky'ebyo bikorwa, reero orangye ekishushani orikurugiirira aha kunoonyereza.

question: Omuhwezi omu mwaka gwa kana omuishomero erikuru, omu kubumbura omutwe 'Okucwamu Endimi z'Obuhangwa ez'Obunaku Bwaitu', omugurusi areeta emirimo y'omufotozi Man Ray orikukora ebintu ebitarikumanyirwa arikushobororera abegi, kandi n'ashoborora amakuru g'ekishushani kya rayogram, arikukishoborora nk'omuringo gw'okutunga ebishushani otarikukoresa kamera. Ku amaze kushoborora, abegi abamwe nibagamba ngu tibarikwetegyereza amakuru g'ekintu eki, reero omugurusi acwamu kuteera akarimi akarikushushanisa omuringo ogu n'embeera ebaireho buri izooba. Ni mbeera ki ebaireho buri izooba ei omuringo gw'ekishushani kya rayogram guraashushanisibwe?
answer_a: N'ebishushani endiro erikurikaamu obu omushana gwaata omuri yo
answer_b: N'ebizibu ebirugire omu misiri egy'eizooba aha ruhu orikukwata aha mpeta
answer_c: N'ebishushani ebirikureebeka aha itaka twaba turikuzibira omushana n'ekintu
answer_d: N'ebirango omukondo gureka aha bwaire obu guba gushangirwe izooba

question: Omuhwezi arikugambira aha kutebeekateeka kw'ekicweka ky'okubuurira ekirikukoresa obuhangwa bw'omulembe (Multimedia Installation unit), omu mwaka gwa kabiri gw'eshomero erikuru, omwegyesa naija kukoragana n'abegi aha kigyendererwa eki: "Kuhanga ekicweka ky'okubuurira ekirikukoresa obuhangwa bw'omulembe omu mwanya gw'eshomero, kushohora abantu b'omu ishomero aha buzibu bw'obwire n'eby'obutonde." Abegi nibaija kukora omu bibiina kutebeekateeka eky'okukora, eki kiraayorekwa omu mwanya gw'eshomero. Kumanya ki okw'okubanza okurikwetagisa abegi kugira ngu bakore gye ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Omuringo gw'okukora purojekiti z'ebishushani
answer_b: Emitwarize erikukoresibwa omu mirimo y'okutebeekanisa ebintu bya multimedia
answer_c: Ebintu ebirikworeka omuringo ogu orurengo rw'okuhurira n'okureeba birikukoresa.
answer_d: Emisingye y'ebyetengo omu by'okutunga ebiragiro omu muringo ogurikukoresa obuhangwa bwona

question: Omuhanda gw’okukora ebishushani omu rurembo rw’abana omu mwaka ogwa kana omu ishomero erikuru, omwegyesa hamwe n’abegyi be bakasoma ebyafaayo by’omurandizimu n’ebirango byagwo ebirikukirayo obukuru, nibongyera aha byo bayegire n’orugyendo rw’okwegyesa omu Ggyenda Eryererezi erya Valparaíso, kubaasa kukora enyikiriza zaabo ez’okukora ebishushani. Bwanyima y’omurimo gw’okugyenda, omwegyesa areeta nk’okushomesa okurikukwata aha purojekiti, okutebeekanisiza ebintu ebirikukuratira ahaiguru y’ekigyendererwa eki: “Okugamba aha biteekateeko ebirikushemeza omuntu okuraba omu kukora ekishushani ekyahandiikirwe ebikorwa bibiri kuruga omu Ggyenda Eryererezi erya Valparaíso”. Noorekire ekigyendererwa ky’okushomesa ekireetsirwe, murimo ki oguriba oguhikire kwongyera omu bintu ebirikukuratira?
answer_a: Yombeka ebishushani by'ebisoro ebi orondire, hamu n'ebiteekateeko byaawe n'okucwamu kw'oburungi bw'ebyo bikorwa.
answer_b: Omushingye gw'okubangaanisa ekishushani aha rurembo, ogurikwetenga ebikoresho, obwire, n'emiringo y'okukikora.
answer_c: Kuhiga efaayiro z'ebishushani ebyatoorainwe, omubairemu ebi biteekateeko n'ebirikwetegyereza aha mirimo egyo hamwe n'ebishushanyo byabyo.
answer_d: Handi ebirowoozo, ebishushani, hamu n'ebishushanyo by'omulingo omulimo ogwo gwatungwa, okutwaliza hamu n'ebishushani ebirukusangwa hamu n'amanyonyoona g'emilimo eyacweirwe.

question: Omumwe aha bintu ebi orikukoresa kushashuura omurimo gw'abaana arikukwata aha kicweka "Okwetegyereza Abahanga b'Ebiro Ebi n'Okukora Omurimo Gwabo nk'Oku Baagukozire," omu kiraasi ya 4 omu mashomero g'ahaiguru, omwegyesa naakora n'abaana be aha murimo gwabo ogw'okubanza, ogurikugizibwa omu kubaha omurimo gw'okushahoora omu bibinja, ogurikugira ekigyendererwa eki: "Okucwekyereza aha mitwarize n'embeera z'omuringo ogu emirimo gy'abahanga b'ebiro ebi erikukorwa." Aha muheru gw'okushahoora, omwegyesa naija kushashuura emirimo y'abaana arikukoresa akagambo k'okushashuurira. Ni bintu ki ebi orikubaasa kuteeka omu kagambo k'okushashuurira ebirikukworeka ngu ekigyendererwa kikahiirweho?
answer_a: Nibarikira omu bumenyi bwabo ekigendererwa ky'okwohereza ky'ebihangirwe by'omulembe ebiriho ebitegyekanirwe omu kitongole ekiherireyo.
answer_b: Nibarikora omugisha gw'okubazaara ekikorwa ky'obugugu ekya hati, nibateekateeka aha mitwarize erimu omu itungo eryashomwe.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza ebimanyiso by'ebihangirwe by'omulembe ogwa hati eby'ekibiina eki beeteeraine, nibahuriraana nabyo n'embeera z'abantu n'eby'omugisha by'obutaka.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza okutorana eby'obuganga by'omulembe ogu, kuruga omu kibina eki barondire, nibateekateeka aha bintu ebi barikukunda n'omukago ogu baine n'ebyo barikuhikwaho.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekyangahe omwaka ogw'omukaaga, omu mutwe gw'Ekyevugo n'Omuziki, araakore n'abeeshuri be emyitooro y'ebicweka by'omuziki, nukwo bashobore kubikora n'ebirikoresibwa n'okubimanya omu myitooro y'okuhurikiza. Murimo ki oguhikire kukuzamu okwetegyereza kw'abeeshuri okw'ebicweka by'omuziki?
answer_a: Huura ebirango by'omuziki ebirimu endengo n'ebigambo
answer_b: Shushana orikuriku orikumiriza ebishushani ebirikukwatagana n'omuringo gw'ebicurangiro omu nyimbo
answer_c: Gendagenda orikwirikiza ebirango by'omuziki ogw'omutindo.
answer_d: Yoreka oburyo ebicweka by'omuziki birikukuratura omu ruzito

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekyangahe ari kukoresa okwegyesereza kw’okubanza kw’omuziki gw’enyeezi, engitaara, n’engoma. Omu kwegyesereza, arikwija kukimanya ngu omu kibinja ky’enyeezi, abegyirizibwa abamwe tibarikukora eby’okugyema bya staccato omu rurembo rw’ebicurangari. Nk’okugarukamu, acwireho kuhindura omuringo gw’ekyangahe ahabw’okuhindura okukora okutahikire okurikwolekwa abegyirizibwa abo. Kiki eki omwegyesa ashemereire kukora ahabw’okuhindura okurekyeraaho kwa staccatos omu kukora?
answer_a: Mubyare hamwe n'abeeshuri omuby'ahandiikirwe, murondoorere obugumu kandi mugyende nimuzaamu okuhitsya obu murihikiiriza omuringo ogurikukwata.
answer_b: Tebeekanisa omugani gwona, hanyuma y’eklassi, shaba abacuranga omubanda kureeba, omu maka, oku barikucuuranga omu ndeesho.
answer_c: Kora omwegyegyeso gw'omuntu omwe omu klasse ogurikugaba omwanya gw'okweyongyera kureeba n'omwe omwe omwegi orikugumirwa omu kashomo akarikwoleka obugumirizi omu kukora ebintu.
answer_d: Ruhangya okwetegereza okwegyezamu hamu nooshoborora abeeshumi omusingi ogurikukwata aha biteekateeko by'okuzaana omuziki omu muringo ogurikwata aha nshonga ezi barikutoorana.

question: Omugyezaho arikwegyesa abegi b'ekitaano obwengye bw'okuhurikiza. Kandi aza kubareetera enyimba ez'emitindo n'ebihogoora ebiirikushushana ahabw'ekigyendererwa ky'okureetera abegi kumanya ebiri omu nyimba nk'omuririmbo n'ebirikugwatanisa, okuririmba hamwe, okuririmba omu miringo erikushushana n'ebindi. Ni bitabo ki by'enyimba ebirikukwatanisa n'obwengye oburikukura n'ekigyendererwa eki omwegyesa arikwenda kukoresa?
answer_a: Ebiragiro n'obubonero
answer_b: Ebiragiro n'akagambo k'omuziki
answer_c: Vidiyo na muzigramu
answer_d: Vidiyo hamu n'omutaano

question: Omugyezibwa naija kukoragana n'abanyeshuri be ab'ekitaano omu kumanya obukugu bw'okucuranga ebintu n'okwimba omu bwihuriro, ahabw'entebeekanisa y'ekikundi y'omuziki gw'omu Latin America. Okurikurugirira aha mbeera eyo eyaherize, muguzo ki ogurikukwata aha nshonga ogu abanyeshuri bashemereire kuba bakozire kare kutandika kukuza omurimo gwa polyphonic?
answer_a: Okushoma emyito ya polyrhythmic, okukonakona n'okutindika
answer_b: Okuronda kurungi okw'ekanon y'enyimba enyakubiri omurundi gumwe, kurikumirwa n'omukwenda.
answer_c: Okuririmba endengo z'omurundo omuhanda omu, ahu buri kimu omukikundi kirikuririmba omuririmbo gumwe gw'enyimba ezigyendaine.
answer_d: Okuranga omuhanda gw'okuririmba n'ebigambo birikukwata aha biteekateeko by'omuziki bitarikugumire hamwe n'okukora ebintu by'ebicurangiro omuhanda murungi.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omu mwaka ogwa 7 amala kumaliza omutwe ogurikugira ekigyendererwa eki: "Okuririmba n’okucwara enyimbo ez’emiringo mingi, n’okukuraaza obwengye nk’okuhikiza obwire n’endyo; n’okukoresa ebintu ebirungi ebirikuranga omuziki." Kureeba yaaba ekigyendererwa eki kyahikiiriziibwe, naija kucweera abaana omuziki omwe-omwe kuraba omu kuririmba nari omu kucwara ebintu by’omuziki eby’enyimbo za Chile, arikukoresa ebintu ebirikuranga endyo n’obuhangwa (endere, ekyoma, omuziki, keyiboodi, gitara, na yukurere). Ni bitebe by’okuranga ebiri kukwasa kumanya yaaba ekigyendererwa eki kyahikiiriziibwe?
answer_a: Nibakora omuhanda ogurikuruguruka ogw'enyimba omu buringaaniza.
answer_b: Nibarikoresa amaani g'ebicurangiro omu muringo ogurikwetagisa nk'oku biri omu nyimbo. ■ Nibakuumira obuhikire bw'omuringo gw'okucuranga omu kubahoza enyimbo, nibakurata obuhikire oburikworekwa omu rupapura rw'enyimbo.
answer_c: Nibarikuteera omutindo gw'enyimba n'ebirikurugaho omu nyimbo nk'oku biri. ■ Nibakozesa gye ebintu nk'omuringo gw'okuteera n'amaani omu kufeerereza.
answer_d: Nibakora omulingo gw'omuziki n'endirimbo nk'oku biri omu kacweka. ■ Nibongyeramu ebintu omu kushoborora nk'okwemerera, okuterereza, n'okugambira hamu n'ebindi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'eky'omukaaga aza kwetegyereza ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: "Okweshushanisa kuraba omu kuwurira emitindo y'ebiragiro by'omuziki n'ebintu by'orurimi rw'omuziki, n'okubikirira omu miringo etari emwe". Murimo ki ogurikugambwa omwegyesa ogurikukiriza kwetegyereza ekigyendererwa ekigambirwe?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibahurira ebikorwa by'omuziki bitari bimwe na bimwe, bwanyima bakakora ekikombe ky'ebipande barikukoresa ebisharizi by'enyemoozi ezirikuruga omu muziki ou bahurire.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibahurira ebicweka by'enyimbi ez'okushisha ezo bakunda, reero bakahandiika omutwe ogurikworeka ebi barikuteekateeka ebirikuruga omu nyimbi ezo.
answer_c: Abeshomesha nibahurira omwiziki ogurikuruga omu magomero gaabo agari haihi, bwanyima, omu bibiina, bakakora enkoresa y'omubiri erikwoleka ebyesiimiso ebirikuruga omu kuhurira kwabo
answer_d: Abeshomesa nibahurira omuziki emirundi mingi nibwo barikukora ekishushani ekitari kyabuliijo (abstract drawing) kuraba omu ebara, emishobooro n'emirongo, ebirikworeka ebintu ebirikumuhurirwamu.

question: Omuhendiisa omu, arikutandika omutwe ogurikugamba aha Kushushaniisa omu Bwomeezi bw'Obuhangwa bw'Omuriizo, ogurikugyenda aha muheto gw'ebishushani omu mbeera z'obuhangwa, naija kukora okucungura okw'okubanza kumanya yaaba abeeshuri be ab'ekika kya 6 nibamanya ekigyendererwa ky'okwoleka ekirikurugamu omu bishushani eby'omutwaro. Ku araabe yaashoma eby'abeeshuri bamugarukire, naashanga ngu abeeshuri abarikukiraho nibooleka obureezi bw'emirongo, emiterere, n'erangi z'ebishushani, batarikworeka ebi birikworeka. Eki nikimworeka ngu ashemereire kukoragana nabo aha kwetegyereza omulingo ebishushani ebi birikworeka. Omu mirimo egi erikukurira omunsi yoona, niki ekirikukonyera abeeshuri kwetegyereza omulingo baine kucungura ekigyendererwa ky'okwoleka ky'ekishushani?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naabuuza abeeshuri kureeba ebikorwa by'obugombe bw'omulembe ogu, bamanye n'emiramu erikugarukwamu omu bikorwa ebi.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa naayoreka abeshomesa ebikorwa by'obugubi bw'omulembe ogwa hati, reero abagambire kumanya emigyenzo y'okwoleka n'emiringo egikozesibwe abagubi.
answer_c: Omugyezaho naayoreka abegi emirimo etari emwe y'ebyahangwa by'omuri obu bwire, reero abashaba kuhandiika enyehurira ezi ebaraara nari emishushani eyorokwa omuri yo ebateera.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa areetera abeeshuri eby’okureeberaho by’ebikorwa by’obugubi bw’omulembe ogu, reero abagambira kworeka embeera y’ensi abakugu abakozese ebyo bakaba baine kurugiirira aha kucweekereza ebintu ebi bareebire omu bikorwa ebyo.

question: Omwegyesereza omuhwezi omu wa 6 akagambire ekigyendererwa eki ahabw'okwebeza kw'okumanya: "Kushushaniisa kuraba omu kushushana n'obwinganiza bw'omubiri gw'omuntu." Nk'omurimo mukuru omu kiraasi, ahaire abegi omurimo gw'okukora ebishushani bisatu by'omuntu: ekishushani ky'omwana, ekindi ky'omukuru, n'ekindi ky'omukaire. Ku yaakiriize emirimo, omuhwezi areeba ngu abegi abamwe bakashushaniise emibiri y'abantu nka "emigamba," kandi acwa orubanja ngu ekibiina eki kiragire oburemeezi omu kushushaniisa ebintu omu bwengye bushatu. N'ekirikurugaho, acwamu kutandika eishomo eririkukuraho arikugambira aha kicweka eki ky'okwega. Aha mirimo erikukuraho, niki ekirikwija kureka omuhwezi kugumya omugisha ogu ogw'okumanya ogwazoirwe nk'ogurikugumira abegi be?
answer_a: Reeba ebishushani by'omuntu omu bitabo by'ebyetengo by'omubiri omu maisho n'aha rubaju, reero okopi ebishushani ebyo by'omubiri ogwo ogweshomesereize.
answer_b: Huunganisa eby'omubiri eby'ekikalati n'ebicweka by'omubiri ebirikushushana, reero obikoresye kukora ebishushani by'omuntu.
answer_c: Pima emiringo y'omubiri gw'omunywani waawe omu omuhanda, orohoze omukago oguri ahagati y'ebicweka byabo, reero okore ebishushani ebirikubaasa kworeka omubiri gw'omunywani waawe omu omuhanda.
answer_d: Shushani emisingi n'oburyo bw'ebicweka by'omubiri omu bishushani by'abantu kwongyeraho ebishushani byabo, reero okore copy z'ebishushani by'abantu abashushaniiziibe.

question: Omugyezaho naatandika omutwe gw'ebifaananyi bya Tekinologia omu by'okushushana n'abegi b'eky'omushanju. Omugyezaho naatebya omurimo ogurikukurataho abegi: kuhanga ebishushani by'ensi ebirooto kuruga omu kushushana kw'ekikomo omu puroguramu y'okuhindura ebifaananyi. Ni bumanyi ki bw'omulingo obw'omusingi abegi bashemereire kumanya kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa?
answer_a: Ebikoreso by'okurwanisa sitirooku
answer_b: Okureeberera ebikoreso by'okuhindura ebintu
answer_c: Okureeberera ebikoreso by'okucwa n'okutaaha
answer_d: Okutebeekanisa ebikorwa eby'okutorana ebikozesebwa

question: Omugyezibwa naaba naakora omutwe Abantu n'Eitaka omu kiraasi ey'omunaana, arikuteekateeka ekigyendererwa: "Okukora ekiikaro ky'amagara gye okurikusiigikwa aha biteekateeko, ebirooto, n'emyekubo kuruga omu magara gaabo." Okukora ekiikaro eki, omugyezibwa naateekateeka kukoresa omuringo gw'okugyegaana. Murongo ki gw'ebikorwa ogurikukwata aha kugyenda n'abayegi omu kukora ekiikaro kyabo ky'amagara gye?
answer_a: Teeka ekikoomi ekirikukwata, oroboorore ebicweka byakyo ebihendaanhenda, taaha omu maapu yaakyo, reero otaahizeemu obucweka bw'ekikoomi ekyo.
answer_b: Shuula ebishushani omu maapu, otwariramu okushushana n'okuchuura, orukurukure ebifo by'ensi ebirikushushanisibwa omukyo.
answer_c: Ninkakora ekitabo ekirikukwata aha magara gangye, ncwe ncweekyerereza amataagi g'ebishushani by'ensi omu muringo ogutari gumwe, nkore ekishushani ky'ensi, nteekyere hamu ebishushani ebicumiirwe n'okushushana.
answer_d: Teekateekateeka aha biikwaikuru byabo, okungaania hamu n'okuta omukopi aha rupapura rurikuru, okushushana ekiikaro, n'okutwaramu okusiiga

question: Omugabe naija kukorera hamwe n'abanyeshuri b'eky'omukaaga aha kiragiro eki: "Kukuraaza emishomo y'okucapa omu muringo gw'okukozesa tekiniki ya monotype y'ebara". Buki bwa kumanya ki abanyeshuri abarikwetenga kuba baine kubaasa kukozesa tekiniki egi omu muringo ogurikuhikire?
answer_a: Kushushanura ebara
answer_b: Okukoresa eby'empapura
answer_c: Kutaaha ekikopo
answer_d: Okugyezibwa kw'ebizina bya gavumenti omu muringo gw'okukora ebishushani

question: Omu omukuru omu iraaya ry'omunaana, omu bwiire bw'ekicweka ky'ebyamashushani eby'omulembe, omwegyesa naaba naagamba aha nshonga y'okutebeekanisa. Okukora eki, abegyeswa bareebire vidiyo z'okutebeekanisa okutari kumwe, kandi hamwe baashanga emitwarize y'ekika ky'eby'obuhangwa eki. Nk'omurimo gw'ahaheru, abegyeswa, abarikutebeekanisibwa omu turuupu, bakakora okutebeekanisa okw'obwire obuhango omu iraaya, nibakoresa ebintu ebirugire omu maka gaabo. Ku arikurinda omurimo ogu, omwegyesa naareeba ngu erimu aha turuupu neekora emishumo etarikumanywa n'obusingye obugumire aha rusika rw'iraaya. Ni enshonga ki etarikwetegyereza aha bikwatiraine n'ebirikukorwa omu kutebeekanisa erikworekwa omu murimo ogurikwolekwa abegyeswa?
answer_a: Tibarukiriza emiringo ekukozesibwa n'obusaale obwozoire omu mwanya ogukozesibwe okuteekateeka.
answer_b: Tibarikurora omutaano gw'obuhwezi ekiina ky'okuteekateeka kirikuba nikigira.
answer_c: Tibarikukoresa obusumi bwona omu kubahoza ebiteekateeko ebitari bimwe ebi ekitebeekanisa kirikubaasa kugira.
answer_d: Tibarikurora emitwarize y'ebintu ebirikubaasa kukoresibwa omu kuzombeka ekintu.

question: Ahabuurizi omuheru gw’ekicweka aha by’okutaho n’eby’obugombe bw’omulembe ogu, omwegyesa naija kucungura abegi be ab’omu mwaka gwa munaana (8) aha bikwaata aha kutuuraana ekigyendererwa eki: “Kuhangira hamwe eky’okutaho omu klasiruumu kurugiirira aha kuteekateeka aha mukago oguri ahagati y’abantu n’obutonde.” Ni mirimo ki y’abegi erikwoleka okutuuraana ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibakozesa amarangi n'ebintu ebirikukoresibwa kubyezibwa ebi barikureeta kuruga omu maka gaabo, kandi babiteeka omu myanya etari emwe omu klasiruumu.
answer_b: Abeshomesa nibata omwerorerezi ahaiguru y’orutara omu emwe aha mpisho z’ekikaikuru, kurora omuhanda ogwabingyizibwemu obwatsi, ebiragala, hamu n’ebishushani by’obururu ebyakozirwe ekikundi.
answer_c: Abeshuri niboohanga ebyambaro kuruga omu ngoye ezikozirweho omurundi gwa kabiri ezirikukurirwa enkyukakyuka y’obwire, ezi bambarwa boona haine nibashoboorora oku bazihangire.
answer_d: Abeshomesha nibakora vidiyo erimu ebishushani by'ekyombeko ky'eky'omumashomo ekihindurirweho omuringo ogw'eby'omutwe n'ebishushani ebirikworeka obutonde, nibahindura embeera y'ekifo ekihindurirwe.

question: Omwegyesereza, omuheereza omu iraaya ry'aha mwanya gwa 3 omuishomero, omu mutwe gw'Eki Enyimba Zituraganisa, naatandika kwegyesa ekigyendererwa eki: "Kuhanga omurimo gw'enyimba muto hamwe kurugiirira aha mbeera y'ebihuriirwa, nibakoresa eiraka ryabo, emibiri yaabo, ebintu by'okucuranga, n'ebintu ebindi by'okuhuriirwa, kubaasa kucweera omu bihuriirwa ebiheereza abeeshumi." Ni muringo ki ogurikukwata aha beeshuuri kutandika kukora aha kigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Kushaba kuseruliiza ebintu ebirikukwata aha majwi ebirikworobiiza omulingo gw'okuhanga omuziki
answer_b: Kukora okunoonyereza aha mbeera y'ebihogo omu byaro n'omu rurembo
answer_c: Kutahoora n'okuhurikiza amaraka agatali gamwe agarikukora ebirikukwata aha mbeera y'amaraka.
answer_d: Kutorana ebintu by'omuziki ebi buri omwe omu itswekanisa arikukozesa gye, reero bakabiteera omu mwanya gw'abantu boona.

question: Omuhwezi omu secondary ey'okubanza naija kukorera hamwe n'abeshuri aha kiragiro eki: "Okumanya emiringo y'okuhindura ebara ry'omuziki n'oku gikozesibwa omu mikorere y'omuziki etari emwe." Omuhwezi ashobooroire ebi biteekateeko, kwonka acwiremu kworeka omu bwijwire omuringo ogu gw'omuziki arikukoresa orugero. Orurugero ruruha ahansi nirwo rurikukwata aha kwongyera okwetegyereza kw'abeshuri aha biteekateeko by'okuhindura ebara ry'omuziki?
answer_a: Omu biraama n'ebikoreso by'omushana, nikibaasika kushangamu oburemeezi bw'emibala y'omurunga ogw'enkuba obu ebintu birikworeka nk'ebyetooloire emibala y'omurunga ogw'enkuba.
answer_b: Aha kiboodi, enyota D, D sharp, na E nibisangwa; rundi, E, E flat, na D, ezi ziri enyendo ezirikukurira hamwe.
answer_c: Omu kwega aha bikwaato, okuhindura eya 3 n'eya 5, ebikwaato bikuru, bitari bikuru, ebirikukendeera, n'ebirikweyongyera nibyo byombwa.
answer_d: Omu kubazaano, nikibaasika kureeba okuhinduka kw'emibala, ahu turishanga okucweeka kw'emibala, nk'oku kuruga omu rubaraara okugyenda omu burunga bw'omuchungwa reero okugyenda omu rwaatsi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa pulayimare, owa kabiri, omu mutwe gw'eky'okwegera 'Ebi Turukugambirwa Omuruli', naija kushwijuma abegi n'ekigyendererwa eki: "Kushwijuma omu muringo ogurikwetengyesa ebiragiro n'emirimo y'omuruli kuruga Chile n'ensi yoona ebirukugarukwamu omu ndimi, ebihandiiko, n'obuhangwa obumanyirwe, nibarukugambira aha ntandikiro yaabyo kuraba omu ndimi, ebimanyiso, ebi turukuhurra, n'omubiri." Ahabw'omurimo ogu, abegi baine kuteeka akabonero k'omukura gwabo aha murimo gwabo. Omu mirimo ei orikukurataho, niki ekirikukwataana kushwijuma ekigyendererwa eki kirukugambwaho?
answer_a: Shwijuma omuhanda gw'okuririmba ogurikukirayo obukuru omu kitundu kyaawe, orikumanya ebipimo byagwo, omuringo gwagwo, oburemeezi bwagwo, n'omutindo gwagwo.
answer_b: Rooraho omucwezi orikweshongora omuhandiiki w'enyeshongoro orikukirira omu kitundu kyanyu, omuhandiikeho eby'afaayo by'omulimo gwe gw'okuririmba.
answer_c: Shwijuma omutwe gw'orw'omuziki n'omuhandiiki orikumanywa kuruga omu kaaro kaanyu, orikuhuumurira aha mazima g'orurembo.
answer_d: Teeka erikwata aha ndwi z'enyimba ezirikukundwa abacwezi omu bbaala z'omu kitundu kyaitu, n'okushoborora ekika kyazo, abazihandiikiise, n'abazihimba:

question: Omwegyesereza, omwegyesa omu klasse y'aha mwaka gwa kabiri omu mashomero ga sekenda, naija kushwijuma okwegyesa kw'abegyeswa aha kigyendererwa eki: "Omuhanga omuryo gw'okucurra omuzingo gw'ebicurizo ogw'omutwaro gwa Tom na Jerry, orikukoresa ebintu by'okucurra ebirikushusha, ebintu ebirikukoresebwa buri izooba n'ebikoreso bya mashanyarazi." Okukora eki, bashemereire kukora omurimo ogurikukwata aha kucurra, ogurikubaasa kworekwa omu bwire bw'ekyegyeso nari omu vidiyo. Aha ndaga zirikukurira, niziha ezirikubaasa kworeka ngu ekigyendererwa kyahikiirirwe?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza okutunga omukago oguhikire hagati y'orukurato rw'ebishushani n'omuziki ogukozirwe.
answer_b: Nibakoresa amarangiriro n'emibazi y'amaajwi etari emwe n'emwe egi yongyera obugagga omu kutebeekanisibwa kw'omuziki okurikwetengwa
answer_c: Nibakoresa ebirikukwata aha muuziki omu muringo ogurikwihirira aha mbeera n'omuntu omu katuni.
answer_d: Nibakoresa obuhangwa bw'omuteeknology omuhanda murungi omukugyendera aha byetengo by'omuziki eby'ekiteekateeko ky'ebihuriira.

question: Omugyezibwa na-omugurusi ari kutebeekaniza omutwe "Okucapa n'Ebitabo by'Omucwezi" ahabwa ekibiina kya Year 1, kurugiirira aha kiragiro eki: "Kumanya n'okukoresa obuhangwa bw'okucapa." Aha isomo rya bwambere, akasorora obuhangwa bw'okugarukamu ebishushani oburikwija kumuha omugisha okutandika n'okucapa kandi oburikuhikaana n'omuringo gw'eishomo, ahabw'okuba abeeshuri tibarikugira bikoreso by'omutaano. Murimo ki ogurikwija kwiha abeeshuri omugisha kwihaho ekiragiro eki?
answer_a: Teekate eby'okushushana by'okucapa aha sikiriini
answer_b: Tebeekanisa omuringo gw'okukora linokati
answer_c: Kora omugani gw'okuhangaanisa ebintu omu matiriksi orikukoresa drypoint
answer_d: Kutandika bizinesi nshya kurugiiziyo y'omutwe gw'ebirikugambwaho abeeshuri baronda.

question: Okwegyeragyeranisa okuza omwegi kw'omukuru: "Okuteekateeka munonga aha bitegyerezo by'orurimi rw'amaisho n'amatu." Omu ishomo erya kabiri ery'ekicweka ky'endimi z'ebyentegyereza n'eby'amasannyalaze, omwegyesa akaba naakora n'abegi b'omwaka ogwa kana arikugyenderera aha: "Okuteekateeka munonga aha bitegyerezo by'orurimi rw'amaisho n'amatu." Omu ishomo, akagambaana n'abegi aha kashoti, ekifo, n'omutendera gw'amaisho n'amatu, arikwoleka eby'okureeberaho arikukoresa obutambi bw'emifiriimu etarikwerabwa. Ku baamaze kureeba eby'okureeberaho, omwegi omwe akimutsya engaro yaagira ngu tarikumanya enjura eriyo hagati y'ekifo n'omutendera gw'amaisho n'amatu. Okushoboorora ki okuza omwegyesa okurikushoboorora okutahurira kw'omwegi n'okuhikiiriza eby'okureeberaho ebyoolekirwe?
answer_a: Ekicweka n’akatambi akarikuragyiirwa kuruga obu kamera etandika okureeta ebishushani okuhitsya obu etemura. Ekihurikizo nikyo kubungaania hamwe ebicweka ebi.
answer_b: Ekintu kirugaho abantu abarikukora omu katambi ku baatandika kugyeenda omu by'ebarikugamba. Obukwaikuru, orukurato nirurugaho ekirikugyeenda ni kamera.
answer_c: Ekicweka n’akacwe kamakuru agambwaho ekintu ekirikukiraho omunonga gumwe. Obu, orukurato rw’ebyamashusho n’amajwi nirureetera embeera yoona ey’amahega, erimu okutandika, okukura, n’okuherera.
answer_d: Ekibanja kigambwa omuhanda gw'omunonga n'obwire obu ekigyendererwa kirikukorerwa. Kukuru, omusorongo nigworeka gye ekigyendererwa, niguteekateeka eby'obusinge bw'ekibarizo ebirikubaasa kworekwa kuruga omu myanya n'obwire obutari bumwe.

question: Kandi okukora aha mutwe gw'ekicweka Ekumanya Abakugu Abarikushushaniisa Ab'Obunaku obu n'Okugarukamu Emirimo Yaabo, omwegyesa w'aha mashomero ga secondary ateekanize kukora eishomo n'abegi b'omwaka gwa 4 omu araabe arikwega munonga aha murimo gwa Frida Kahlo, naayorekaho obukuru bw'ebyafaayo by'amagara ge omu bihangwa bye by'obukugu. Nk'omurimo, araabe naashaba abegi kugarukamu ekishushani ekya omukugu ogwo kukurirana n'ebirikubareetera kwetegyereza n'emitindo yaabo bwaine. Omu muringo gw'okuhanga ebishushani, omwegyesa naareeba ngu abegi nibaijutsya emirimo omu mwanya gw'okugigarukamu. Ni bibuzo ki ebirikukwata aha nshonga ahabw'omwegyesa kubuuza abegi kubaheereza obuhabuzi n'okworobiya okwolekereza kwabo bwaine omu mirimo yaabo?
answer_a: Ni nkuru ki ezirikukwata aha magara ga Frida Kahlo ezirikugambwaho omu mirimo ye? Ni bihemuko ki ebi orikureeba ngu arikushoborora? Ni bifaananyi na rangi ki ewaabaasa kukoresa kwolesa ebyo bihemuko?
answer_b: Ogu oteekateeka omulimo gwa Frida Kahlo gwakubaire guri, ku yaabaire atagizire obwomeezi bw'okubonabona kwingi? Nooraata okubonabona okwo? Ni bifaananyi na rangi ki ewaakukozeseze?
answer_c: Ni bikorwa ki ebi mwebagire omu magara gaanyu ebirikumanyisa nk'ebyo ebyabaireho ahari Frida Kahlo? Ni ngyegyere ki ezo ebijukizo ezo ezirikureetera? Ni bifaananyi na rangi ki ebi orikuteekateeka ebirikubaasa kworeka ezo ngyegyere?
answer_d: Noyekurangarira emiringo y'ebishushani bya Frida Kahlo? Omuringo gw'okukoresa ebintu by'orurimi rw'okureeba nigutwara guta aha kworeka ebyendeesa? Miringo ki y'emirimo ye ei waaba nooyenda kworeka omu bishushani byaawe?

question: Omugyezaho w’omuishaaja w’aha secondary, omu kiraasi ky’omwaka gwa kana, ari kutebeekaniza okushwijuma ahabw’okumaliriza omutwe gw’ebya’bwojo eby’omuri obu bwire, ahu ekigyendererwa kiriba kukora enyikiriza n’ebishushani ebirikushushana n’omuringo ogurikukoresibwa abahanga b’ebya’bwojo eby’omuri obu bwire omu mirimo yaabo. Omu mutwe ogu, abeeshuri beegireho abahanga ab’omutaano kuruga omu kicweka kya kabiri ky’ekyasha kya 20, nibashoora omutima aha murimo gw’omuhangi wa pop Roy Lichtenstein, n’ahabw’ekyo okushwijuma kuriba kwongyera kukora ekishushani kya kare n’omuringo gw’okushushana gw’omuhangi ogu. Ni birikurugamu ebiri ahansi ebirikukwata aha kwongyera omu murongo gw’okushwijuma?
answer_a: Nibarikwo nibarikoresa ebintu ebirimu okusekeza n'obusaamirizi omu biteekateeko byabo.
answer_b: Nibakoresa ebara nyingi ez'omubara n'obucweka buto omu miteekateeka yaabo.
answer_c: Nibarikoresa ebishushani n'ebintu ebirukolebwa n'omukono hamwe n'okushushana omu kubanza kwabo.
answer_d: Nibakoresa obutooni, okushara-shara, n'emirongo emirairu kushuubura ebishushani ebikora oruteekateeka rwabo.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omu mwaka gw’okubanza owa siniya, omu mutwe gw’ebya’buhangwa bw’omuringo gw’ekikomo, ari kutebeekaniza okushomesa okurikwetenga ekikopo ky’okubanza ekirikugambira aha: “Okucweekamu ebikorwa by’eby’obuhangwa bw’omuringo gw’ekikomo, orikworeka emiringo erikukwata aha mutwe ogu.” Noora eky’orikwenda omu by’enyorekwa ebi, niki ekishemereire kubaho omu rubriiki y’okushomesa?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza omuko gw'ebirikukorwa, nibashoborora ebi barikuteekateeka n'oku barikubyetegyereza.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza ebishushani ebirikugyirwa hamwe, nibamanyisa omuringo ogurikukoresibwa kukora ebishushani ebyo
answer_c: Nibarikiriza omurimo gwabo gw'obuhangwa bw'omuringo gw'ekikomo, nibagamba aha puroguramu ezikozirweho kukora omurimo ogwo.
answer_d: Nibarikira aha bikorwa by'okushushana eby'omuringo gw'ekikoompyuta, nibashobora eby'okukoresa by'ekikoompyuta ebikozesebwa kworeka ebintu ebirikukwatwa omubiri.

question: Omuhiga omu mwaka gwa kana, aha muheru gwa semesta ya mbere, omwegyesa w’aha mashomero g’ahaiguru naija kushwijuma emirimo y’eby’obuhanga ey’abegi, omuri buri omwe yaakozireho emirimo etari emwe, ebishushani, ebicweka by’oburinganire bubiri n’obushatu. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira eziraakuratirwa omwegyesa kushobora kumanya ebi abegi baayegire, okukurirana n’ekigyendererwa ekishoboirwe?
answer_a: Omuti
answer_b: Ekikopo ky'ebyahandiikwa
answer_c: Ekitabo ky'omuhangaizi
answer_d: Okutegyereza omu bwa bukuru

question: Shoma omubaire omu class ya high school ey'omwaka ogwa kabiri atebeekaniise omugongo gw'okushomesa okucungura okukora kw'ekigyendererwa ekirikukurataho: "Nibashwijuma za video nibashoborora omuhanda gw'okukorera hamwe n'orurimi rw'amaisho n'amatu." Omu biteekateeko ebirikukurataho, ekiheebwa ki ekishemereire kuba kiriyo omu mugongo gw'okushomesa?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebintu ebirikworekwa n'okuhurirwa omu kubaanura ebicweka, okukwata, n'obwire.
answer_b: Nibareeba vidiyo kandi bagamba ebi barikusiima aha biteekateeko ebirikwoherezibwa.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza ebi barikuteekateeka aha vidiyo kurugiirira omu byabahandiika byabo.
answer_d: Nibakoresa ebi barikugarukamu omu kubuuzabuza kwabo omu by'obuhangwa kukuhigaana ebi barikwenda kukora omu purojekiti y'ebirikumanyisa n'ebirikureebwa.
